tools.name: Skill
tools.description:
Invoke a skill.

A skill is a packaged set of instructions the user or project has set up for a particular kind of task (deploy steps, a review checklist, a repo-specific workflow). Available skills appear in a system-reminder listing with one-line descriptions. When the task at hand is one a listed skill covers, call this tool first — the skill's instructions load into the turn for you to follow in place of your default approach; some skills instead run in a subagent and return the finished result. A skill that runs in the background returns only the agent's name — its result arrives later as a task notification, so don't wait on it or invoke it again in the meantime. Users may also ask for one by name (`/<name>`, or "slash command"); that's a request to invoke it.

- `skill`: exact name from the listing, no leading slash. Plugin skills use `plugin:skill`. Directory-scoped skills are listed with a path prefix (`apps/web:deploy`); when both scoped and unscoped variants of a name exist, pick the one whose directory contains the files you're working on (most specific wins; unscoped otherwise).
- `args`: optional arguments to pass through.

Only names from the listing (or that the user typed explicitly) are valid. Built-in CLI commands (`/help`, `/clear`, …) aren't skills. If a `<command-name>` block is already present this turn, the skill is loaded — follow it directly rather than calling again.

tools.name: ToolSearch
tools.description:
Fetches full schema definitions for deferred tools so they can be called.

Deferred tools appear by name in <system-reminder> messages. Until fetched, only the name is known — there is no parameter schema, so the tool cannot be invoked. This tool takes a query, matches it against the deferred tool list, and returns the matched tools' complete JSONSchema definitions inside a <functions> block. Once a tool's schema appears in that result, it is callable exactly like any tool defined at the top of the prompt.

Result format: each matched tool appears as one <function>{"description": "...", "name": "...", "parameters": {...}}</function> line inside the <functions> block — the same encoding as the tool list at the top of this prompt.

Query forms:
- "select:Read,Edit,Grep" — fetch these exact tools by name
- "notebook jupyter" — keyword search, up to max_results best matches
- "+slack send" — require "slack" in the name, rank by remaining terms

# Build New Preview Workflow

**Goal:** Turn user intent into a hardened, reviewable artifact.

**CRITICAL:** If a step directs you to another snapshot file, read it fully and follow it. No exceptions.

Subagents, when the capability is available, are an important part of this workflow. Use them as directed by the workflow steps.
If you need an explicit user instruction to run them, ask once now for the whole workflow run.

## READY FOR DEVELOPMENT STANDARD

A specification is "Ready for Development" when:

- **Actionable**: Every task has a file path and specific action.
- **Logical**: Tasks ordered by dependency.
- **Testable**: All ACs use Given/When/Then.
- **Complete**: No placeholders or TBDs.
- **Sufficient**: No known requirement, acceptance, dependency, or implementation gaps remain unresolved.
- **Coherent**: No unresolved ambiguities or internal contradictions.

## SCOPE STANDARD

A specification should target a **single user-facing goal** within **900–1600 tokens**:

- **Single goal**: One cohesive feature, even if it spans multiple layers/files. Multi-goal means >=2 **top-level independent shippable deliverables** — each could be reviewed, tested, and merged as a separate PR without breaking the others. Never count surface verbs, "and" conjunctions, or noun phrases. Never split cross-layer implementation details inside one user goal.
  - Split: "add dark mode toggle AND refactor auth to JWT AND build admin dashboard"
  - Don't split: "add validation and display errors" / "support drag-and-drop AND paste AND retry"
- **900–1600 tokens**: Optimal range for LLM consumption. Below 900 risks ambiguity; above 1600 risks context-rot in implementation agents.
- **Neither limit is a gate.** Both are proposals with user override.

## Conventions

- Every operational cross-file reference in this workflow is an absolute snapshot path. Open it directly; do not resolve it relative to a skill directory.
- `{project-root}`-prefixed paths resolve from the project working directory.
- Whenever this workflow captures or records a version-control revision, obtain the full canonical identifier directly from version control and preserve it verbatim.

This uses **step-file architecture** for disciplined execution:

- **Micro-file Design**: Each step is self-contained and followed exactly
- **Just-In-Time Loading**: Only load the current step file
- **Sequential Enforcement**: Complete steps in order, no skipping
- **State Tracking**: Persist progress via spec frontmatter and in-memory variables

# ==================
# Epic Status:
#   - backlog: Epic not yet started
#   - in-progress: Epic actively being worked on
#   - done: All stories in epic completed

# Compile Epic Context

**Task**
Given an epic number, the epics file, the planning artifacts directory, and a desired output path, compile a clean, focused, developer-ready context file (`epic-<N>-context.md`).

**Steps**

1. Read the epics file and extract the target epic's title, goal, and list of stories.
2. Scan the planning artifacts directory for the standard files (PRD, architecture, UX/design, product brief).
3. Pull only the information relevant to this epic.
4. Write the compiled context to the exact output path using the format below.

## Exact Output Format

Use these headings:

```markdown
# Epic {N} Context: {Epic Title}

<!-- Compiled from planning artifacts. Edit freely. Regenerate with compile-epic-context if planning docs change. -->

## Goal

{One clear paragraph: what this epic achieves and why it matters.}

## Stories

- Story X.Y: Brief title only
- ...

## Requirements & Constraints

{Relevant functional/non-functional requirements and success criteria for this epic (describe by purpose, not source).}

## Technical Decisions

{Key architecture decisions, constraints, patterns, data models, and conventions relevant to this epic.}

## UX & Interaction Patterns

{Relevant UX flows, interaction patterns, and design constraints (omit section entirely if nothing relevant).}

## Cross-Story Dependencies

{Dependencies between stories in this epic or with other epics/systems (omit if none).}
```

## Rules

- **Scope aggressively.** Include only what a developer working on any story in this epic actually needs. When in doubt, leave it out — the developer can always read the full planning doc.
- **Describe by purpose, not by source.** Write "API responses must include pagination metadata" not "Per PRD section 3.2.1, pagination is required." Planning doc internals will change; the constraint won't.
- **No full copies.** Never quote source documents, section numbers, or paste large blocks verbatim. Always distill.
- **No story-level details.** The story list is for orientation only. Individual story specs handle the details.
- **Nothing derivable from the codebase.** Don't document what a developer can learn by reading the code.
- **Be concise and actionable.** Target 800–1500 tokens total. This file loads into build's context alongside other material.
- **Never hallucinate content.** If source material doesn't say something, don't invent it.
- **Omit empty sections entirely**, except Goal and Stories, which are always required.

## Error handling

- **If the epics file is missing or the target epic is not found:** write nothing and report the problem to the calling agent. Goal and Stories cannot be populated without a usable epics file.
- **If planning artifacts are missing or empty:** still produce the file with Goal and Stories populated from the epics file, and note the gap in the Goal section. Never hallucinate content to fill missing sections.

# Epic 5 Context: Semantic Search & Filtering

<!-- Compiled from planning artifacts. Edit freely. Regenerate with compile-epic-context if planning docs change. -->

## Goal

Users can find any Entry again by meaning rather than exact keyword match, and narrow results by source and date range, with search input debounced and filter-clearing restoring the full list without a reload. This epic realizes journey UJ-4 (finding a past entry by meaning, then narrowing with filters) and depends on Epic 4's timeline screen (Meus Registros) as the surface search and filtering mount onto. It extends the same `EntriesRepository` port Epic 3 introduced with `list`/`search` capabilities — it introduces no second Entry model — but stands as its own epic because it is its own user-facing milestone, not a structural completion of Epic 4's job.

## Stories

- Story 5.1: Semantic Search with Debounced Input
- Story 5.2: Metadata Filters
- Story 5.3: Combined Search + Filter & Non-Disruptive Clearing

## Requirements & Constraints

- Search is meaning-based, not literal: a query for one word must surface entries that only use a semantically related word, never requiring exact text match.
- Search input is debounced 300ms client-side before any request fires — the backend performs no throttling of its own, so the debounce is entirely the app's responsibility.
- Filtering is limited to source (manual/audio/photo/chat) and date range (`dateFrom`/`dateTo`) only. There is no tag/category filter anywhere — tags exist only as a read-only, embedded field on an Entry (populated by seed data, never user-created or filterable).
- Filtering with no active search term queries the plain entries-list; filtering combined with an active search term queries the semantic-search endpoint, carrying the same filter parameters. Multiple simultaneous filters (and a search term, when present) combine with AND semantics only — never OR.
- Clearing active filters restores the full unfiltered list in place, without a full screen reload or re-mount.
- The app is cloud-only: offline permits viewing already-cached entries but never writing. After a reconnect, the local cache must stay duplicate-free — no entry appears twice.
- A loading indicator appears only once a request exceeds ~300ms; faster responses show no loading UI at all.

## Technical Decisions

- Call the backend only via its function name, never the literal REST path: entries-list at `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/entries-list` (used for `GET /entries` with `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo`/`cursor`/`limit`) and entries-search at `{FUNCTIONS_BASE_URL}/entries-search` (used for `GET /entries/search` with `q`/`source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo`/`limit`, capped at 50). Note entries-search has **no** `cursor` parameter — unlike entries-list, it is not paginated.
- Extend the existing `EntriesRepository` port (owned by `entries/domain`, introduced in Epic 3) with `list` and `search` methods; the port still exposes create and read only in spirit — no update/delete is ever added, and no second Entry model is created for search results.
- Offline carve-out: semantic search has no client-side vector index, so a search attempted offline resolves immediately to `Failure.networkOffline`, exactly like a write — it is never served from the local cache. Plain filtered list reads, by contrast, may still fall back to the cached Hive box.
- Every query dimension (source, date range, the search term itself) must be a server-side query parameter; the Hive box continues to store exactly what the server returned, keyed by id — no local filtering, joining, sorting, or re-deriving of the cached collection is ever implemented client-side.
- Screens in this epic that are single-data-source, single-fetch-lifecycle use the shared generic `Resource<T>` (`idle`/`loading`/`data`/`error`) state wrapper from `core/`, rather than defining a feature-specific sealed state class.
- Repository methods still return `Either<Failure, T>`, consistent with the rest of the app's resilience contract.

## UX & Interaction Patterns

- Search bar: paper-elevated input with a trailing funnel icon, permanently docked at the top of Meus Registros; it is never submitted via a button — only the debounced live query matters.
- Filter chips: sage background, dark-olive text, fully rounded. Single-choice (date range) and multi-choice (source) filters look visually identical and differ only in underlying behavior.
- Filter sheet: a `radiusLg`/`elevation2` bottom sheet with filter groups labeled in the mono-caption text style.
- Representative flow from the design walkthrough: a user searches "ansiedade" and sees results that only mention a related word ("nervosismo"); she then opens the filter sheet and narrows to a date range plus the audio source, and results re-narrow with AND logic.
- Entrance choreography is limited to the two system-wide animations (`sheetUp` for the bottom sheet, `scrimIn` for any scrim) — no other motion is introduced.
- Filter chips and the search/filter surfaces are a tight-fit area for Dynamic Type — verify text does not truncate or clip at the largest accessibility size.

## Cross-Story Dependencies

- Depends on Epic 4: search and filtering operate over the Meus Registros timeline screen and the entries Hive cache Epic 4 already built; there is nothing to search or filter before that exists.
- Depends on Epic 3's `EntriesRepository` port (introduced under `entries/domain`) being extended here rather than replaced — Story 5.1/5.2 add `search`/`list` capabilities to that one existing port.
- Story 5.3 depends on both 5.1 (search) and 5.2 (filters) being in place, since it is specifically the combined-query and clearing behavior layered on top of both.

1	/// `POST /entries`'s four possible origins (`openapi.yaml:345-351`). This
2	/// story only ever produces [manual] (Boundaries: "source=manual for this
3	/// story") — the other three exist here already so the port
4	/// ([EntriesRepository.create]) doesn't need to change shape when Stories
5	/// 3.2/3.3 (audio/photo) and RF10 (chat) start passing them.
6	enum EntrySource { manual, audio, photo, chat }
7	
8	/// A saved journal entry — plain `{id, content, source, chatMessageId,
9	/// occurredAt, serverRevision, createdAt, updatedAt, mediaDurationSeconds}`
10	/// class, no `freezed` (mirrors `AuthenticatedUser`: this feature has no
11	/// need for the union/copyWith machinery `Failure` uses). Boundaries:
12	/// never a field beyond this exact set — `tags`/`piiStatus`/`piiSpans`/
13	/// `embeddingStatus` still belong to later epics, not this story.
14	/// [mediaDurationSeconds] was the one field Story 3.1 deferred (its own
15	/// comment named it "later epics") — spec-3-2 is that story, for the
16	/// `source: audio` entries it produces.
17	///
18	/// [occurredAt]/[createdAt]/[updatedAt] are kept as the backend's own ISO
19	/// 8601 strings rather than parsed into `DateTime` on this entity itself —
20	/// spec-4-1's `groupEntriesByDate()`/`EntryRecordCard`'s own time label
21	/// each parse [occurredAt] at their own call site instead, so a malformed
22	/// string only ever risks throwing at the one place that actually needs
23	/// the parsed value, never here.
24	class Entry {
25	  const Entry({
26	    required this.id,
27	    required this.content,
28	    required this.source,
29	    required this.chatMessageId,
30	    required this.occurredAt,
31	    required this.serverRevision,
32	    required this.createdAt,
33	    required this.updatedAt,
34	    this.mediaDurationSeconds,
35	  });
36	
37	  final String id;
38	  final String content;
39	  final EntrySource source;
40	
41	  /// Non-null only for a [EntrySource.chat]-sourced entry (RF10) — always
42	  /// `null` for this story's [EntrySource.manual] entries.
43	  final String? chatMessageId;
44	  final String occurredAt;
45	  final int serverRevision;
46	  final String createdAt;
47	  final String updatedAt;
48	
49	  /// Non-null only for an [EntrySource.audio]-sourced entry
50	  /// (`AudioEntryCubit.save()`) — `null` for every other source.
51	  final int? mediaDurationSeconds;
52	
53	  @override
54	  bool operator ==(Object other) =>
55	      identical(this, other) ||
56	      (other is Entry &&
57	          other.id == id &&
58	          other.content == content &&
59	          other.source == source &&
60	          other.chatMessageId == chatMessageId &&
61	          other.occurredAt == occurredAt &&
62	          other.serverRevision == serverRevision &&
63	          other.createdAt == createdAt &&
64	          other.updatedAt == updatedAt &&
65	          other.mediaDurationSeconds == mediaDurationSeconds);
66	
67	  @override
68	  int get hashCode => Object.hash(
69	    id,
70	    content,
71	    source,
72	    chatMessageId,
73	    occurredAt,
74	    serverRevision,
75	    createdAt,
76	    updatedAt,
77	    mediaDurationSeconds,
78	  );
79	
80	  @override
81	  String toString() =>
82	      'Entry(id: $id, content: $content, source: $source, '
83	      'chatMessageId: $chatMessageId, occurredAt: $occurredAt, '
84	      'serverRevision: $serverRevision, createdAt: $createdAt, '
85	      'updatedAt: $updatedAt, '
86	      'mediaDurationSeconds: $mediaDurationSeconds)';
87	}

1	import 'package:hive_ce/hive_ce.dart';
2	
3	import '../../core/di/injection_container.dart';
4	import '../../core/network/api_client.dart';
5	import '../auth/domain/repositories/session_repository.dart';
6	import 'data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart';
7	import 'data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart';
8	import 'domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart';
9	import 'domain/services/pending_entry_write_tracker.dart';
10	import 'presentation/cubit/entry_detail_cubit.dart';
11	import 'presentation/cubit/meus_registros_cubit.dart';
12	
13	/// The `entries` Hive box's name — the first `hive_ce` box in the app
14	/// (Code Map). A raw `Box<Map>`, not a generated `HiveObject`/
15	/// `TypeAdapter` (Design Notes: avoids adapter codegen) — spec-4-1's
16	/// `EntriesRepositoryImpl.list()` is this box's first reader
17	/// (`create()`'s own writes were, until then, never read back by
18	/// anything).
19	const entriesBoxName = 'entries';
20	
21	/// Registers the `entries` feature into the project's single `get_it`
22	/// instance (`sl`) — mirrors `features/account/account_injection.dart`'s
23	/// pattern. Called from `setupCoreDependencies()` right after
24	/// `Hive.initFlutter()` (Code Map), which must already have run by the
25	/// time this opens its box.
26	Future<void> registerEntriesFeature() async {
27	  final entriesBox = await Hive.openBox<Map>(entriesBoxName);
28	  sl.registerSingleton<Box<Map>>(entriesBox);
29	
30	  sl.registerLazySingleton<EntriesRemoteDataSource>(
31	    () => EntriesRemoteDataSource(sl<ApiClient>()),
32	  );
33	
34	  sl.registerLazySingleton<EntriesRepository>(
35	    () => EntriesRepositoryImpl(
36	      remoteDataSource: sl<EntriesRemoteDataSource>(),
37	      entriesBox: sl<Box<Map>>(),
38	    ),
39	  );
40	
41	  // spec-4-2 — one shared tracker for all three capture cubits
42	  // (`capture_injection.dart`) *and* `MeusRegistrosCubit` below, so a
43	  // pending write started from any capture cubit is visible to the other
44	  // regardless of which "+" tap created it (Design Notes).
45	  sl.registerLazySingleton<PendingEntryWriteTracker>(
46	    () => PendingEntryWriteTrackerImpl(repository: sl<EntriesRepository>()),
47	    dispose: (tracker) => tracker.dispose(),
48	  );
49	
50	  // spec-4-1 — `MeusRegistrosCubit` is a `lazySingleton`, not a factory
51	  // (Code Map/Boundaries), like `AccountSettingsCubit`: long-lived, so
52	  // `dispose:` wires its `close()` into `get_it`'s own reset lifecycle,
53	  // same convention `account_injection.dart` already uses.
54	  sl.registerLazySingleton<MeusRegistrosCubit>(
55	    () => MeusRegistrosCubit(
56	      sl<EntriesRepository>(),
57	      sl<PendingEntryWriteTracker>(),
58	    ),
59	    dispose: (cubit) => cubit.close(),
60	  );
61	
62	  // spec-4-4 — a `factory`, not a `lazySingleton` (Code Map): each visit to
63	  // `/meus-registros/:id` gets its own throwaway instance
64	  // (`EntryDetailScreen`'s own `dispose()` closes it), mirroring the
65	  // capture cubits' own factory shape rather than `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s
66	  // long-lived one.
67	  sl.registerFactory<EntryDetailCubit>(
68	    () => EntryDetailCubit(
69	      sl<EntriesRepository>(),
70	      sl<PendingEntryWriteTracker>(),
71	      sl<SessionRepository>(),
72	    ),
73	  );
74	}

5	/// Shared text field primitive (prototype-extract.md §6) with the three

8	/// Story 1.3's login/signup screen.
9	class AppTextField extends StatelessWidget {
10	  const AppTextField({
11	    super.key,
12	    this.controller,
13	    this.labelText,
14	    this.hintText,
15	    this.errorText,
16	    this.obscureText = false,
17	    this.keyboardType,
18	    this.textInputAction,
19	    this.onChanged,
20	    this.focusNode,
21	    this.maxLines = 1,
22	  });
23	
24	  final TextEditingController? controller;
25	  final String? labelText;
26	  final String? hintText;
27	
28	  /// Non-null switches the field to the error border state and shows
29	  /// this text below the field (matches `InputDecorator`'s own rule:
30	  /// any non-null value, including an empty string, counts as an error).
31	  final String? errorText;
32	
33	  final bool obscureText;
34	  final TextInputType? keyboardType;
35	  final TextInputAction? textInputAction;
36	  final ValueChanged<String>? onChanged;
37	  final FocusNode? focusNode;
38	
39	  /// `null` allows unlimited lines (e.g. the insertion modal's "Texto"
40	  /// tab); defaults to a single line for form fields like login.
41	  final int? maxLines;
42	
43	  OutlineInputBorder _border(Color color, double width) {
44	    return OutlineInputBorder(
45	      borderRadius: const BorderRadius.all(
46	        Radius.circular(DesignTokens.radiusSm),
47	      ),
48	      borderSide: BorderSide(color: color, width: width),
49	    );
50	  }
51	
52	  @override

54	    return TextField(
55	      controller: controller,
56	      focusNode: focusNode,
57	      obscureText: obscureText,
58	      keyboardType: keyboardType,
59	      textInputAction: textInputAction,
60	      onChanged: onChanged,

62	      minLines: null,

65	      ),
66	      cursorColor: DesignTokens.colorPrimary,

79	        ),

82	        ),

85	        ),

---
title: 'Semantic Search with Debounced Input'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Meus Registros has no way to find an Entry by meaning — a user who phrased a thought differently than how they search for it today finds nothing, and there is no search surface on the screen at all yet.

**Approach:** Add a permanently-docked search bar to Meus Registros, backed by a new `EntriesSearchCubit` (first real `Resource<T>` consumer) that debounces input 300ms and calls a new `EntriesRepository.search()` method against `entries-search`; an empty query reverts to the normal timeline, and offline resolves immediately to `Failure.networkOffline` with no cache fallback.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `EntriesRepository.search(String query)` → `Either<Failure, List<Entry>>`; `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search(String query)` calls `ApiClient.get('entries-search', queryParameters: {'q': query})` — no `limit`/`cursor` (contract has none), decodes `json['data']` with the existing `EntryDto.fromJson` (superset DTO; the response's extra `similarity`/`mode` fields are simply never read, same as other superset fields already dropped at `_toEntry`).
- `search()` is only ever called with a non-empty, already-trimmed query — `EntriesSearchCubit` owns that guarantee; the repository/data source never re-validates.
- On success, persist each returned `EntryDto` to the `entries` Hive box via `_toEntry`'s existing "persist then return" convention (`putAll`, mirrors `list()`). On any `Failure` — including `networkOffline`/`networkTimeout` — return `Left` unmapped; **no** cache-fallback branch (AD-9 carve-out: search has no client-side vector index).
- `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`, starts `ResourceIdle()`. `onQueryChanged(String raw)`: cancel any pending debounce `Timer`; if `raw.trim()` is empty, cancel and emit `ResourceIdle()` synchronously (no request); else restart a 300ms `Timer` that emits `ResourceLoading()` then awaits `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` counter (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation`) discards a result whose generation is stale by the time it resolves.
- `EntriesSearchBar` (new, `presentation/widgets/`): paper-elevated (`colorSurfaceElevated` fill, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`), `Icons.search` convention-equivalent not required (prototype shows no leading icon, just hint text "Buscar nos registros..."), trailing `Icons.filter_list` `IconButton` (44pt tap target, reuses `insertionModalTapTargetMin`) wired to a no-op for this story (filters are 5.2's scope) — never submitted by a button, `onChanged` feeds `cubit.onQueryChanged` directly.
- `MeusRegistrosScreen`: dock `EntriesSearchBar` under the header, above the list; when `EntriesSearchCubit.state` is not `ResourceIdle`, render search results (own skeleton-after-300ms threshold mirroring `_skeletonTimer`/`_showSkeleton`) instead of `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s timeline; `ResourceIdle` shows the existing timeline unchanged.
- Register `EntriesSearchCubit` in `entries_injection.dart` as `lazySingleton` (`dispose: cubit.close()`), same shape as `MeusRegistrosCubit`; add the matching `sl<EntriesSearchCubit>()` resolution assertions to `bootstrap_integration_test.dart`.

**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and AC1–AC4.

**Never:** a `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` param on `search()` (5.2's scope); a second `Entry`/DTO model for search results; a cache-read fallback for search; a functional filter sheet behind the funnel icon; an update/delete method anywhere on `EntriesRepository`.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Semantic match | query "ansiedade" | results include an entry only containing "nervosismo" | N/A |
| Rapid typing | 5 keystrokes within 300ms | exactly one `entries-search` call fires, for the final value | N/A |
| Query cleared | non-empty → empty/whitespace | pending timer cancelled, state → `ResourceIdle`, timeline shown, no request | N/A |
| Offline | any non-empty query, no connectivity | `ApiClient` → `Failure.networkOffline`, no cache fallback | `ResourceError(networkOffline)` rendered |
| Stale response | query A in flight, query B supersedes it | A's result discarded on arrival (generation mismatch) | N/A |
| Slow request | request exceeds 300ms | loading indicator appears | N/A — faster responses show none |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` — add `search(String query)`; update stale "third and last method ... forever" doc comment (AD-11 is create+read-only, not method-count-capped).
- `lib/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart:54-76` — mirror `list()`'s try/catch + `malformedResponse` pattern for `search()`.
- `lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart:54-94` — mirror `list()`'s persist-then-return; no fallback branch.
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/meus_registros_cubit.dart:48-57` — `_generation` pattern to mirror in the new cubit.
- `lib/core/resource.dart` — existing `Resource<T>`; first real consumer.
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart:117-153` — wire the two cubits via nested `BlocBuilder`s.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `EntriesRepository.search(String query)` → `Either<Failure, List<Entry>>`; `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search(String query)` calls `ApiClient.get('entries-search', queryParameters: {'q': query})` — no `limit`/`cursor` (contract has none), decodes `json['data']` with the existing `EntryDto.fromJson` (superset DTO; the response's extra `similarity`/`mode` fields are simply never read, same as other superset fields already dropped at `_toEntry`).
- `search()` is only ever called with a non-empty, already-trimmed query — `EntriesSearchCubit` owns that guarantee; the repository/data source never re-validates.
- On success, persist each returned `EntryDto` to the `entries` Hive box via `_toEntry`'s existing "persist then return" convention (`putAll`, mirrors `list()`). On any `Failure` — including `networkOffline`/`networkTimeout` — return `Left` unmapped; **no** cache-fallback branch (AD-9 carve-out: search has no client-side vector index).
- `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`, starts `ResourceIdle()`. `onQueryChanged(String raw)`: cancel any pending debounce `Timer`; if `raw.trim()` is empty, cancel and emit `ResourceIdle()` synchronously (no request); else restart a 300ms `Timer` that emits `ResourceLoading()` then awaits `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` counter (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation`) discards a result whose generation is stale by the time it resolves.
- `EntriesSearchBar` (new, `presentation/widgets/`): paper-elevated (`colorSurfaceElevated` fill, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`), `Icons.search` convention-equivalent not required (prototype shows no leading icon, just hint text "Buscar nos registros..."), trailing `Icons.filter_list` `IconButton` (44pt tap target, reuses `insertionModalTapTargetMin`) wired to a no-op for this story (filters are 5.2's scope) — never submitted by a button, `onChanged` feeds `cubit.onQueryChanged` directly.

---
title: 'Semantic Search with Debounced Input'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Meus Registros has no way to find an Entry by meaning — a user who phrased a thought differently than how they search for it today finds nothing, and there is no search surface on the screen at all yet.

**Approach:** Add a permanently-docked search bar to Meus Registros, backed by a new `EntriesSearchCubit` (first real `Resource<T>` consumer) that debounces input 300ms and calls a new `EntriesRepository.search()` method against `entries-search`; an empty query reverts to the normal timeline, and offline resolves immediately to `Failure.networkOffline` with no cache fallback.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `EntriesRepository.search(String query)` → `Either<Failure, List<Entry>>`; `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search(String query)` calls `ApiClient.get('entries-search', queryParameters: {'q': query})` — no `limit`/`cursor` (contract has none), decodes `json['data']` with the existing `EntryDto.fromJson` (superset DTO; the response's extra `similarity`/`mode` fields are simply never read, same as other superset fields already dropped at `_toEntry`).
- `search()` is only ever called with a non-empty, already-trimmed query — `EntriesSearchCubit` owns that guarantee; the repository/data source never re-validates.
- On success, persist each returned `EntryDto` to the `entries` Hive box via `_toEntry`'s existing "persist then return" convention (`putAll`, mirrors `list()`). On any `Failure` — including `networkOffline`/`networkTimeout` — return `Left` unmapped; **no** cache-fallback branch (AD-9 carve-out: search has no client-side vector index).
- `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`, starts `ResourceIdle()`. `onQueryChanged(String raw)`: cancel any pending debounce `Timer`; if `raw.trim()` is empty, cancel and emit `ResourceIdle()` synchronously (no request); else restart a 300ms `Timer` that emits `ResourceLoading()` then awaits `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` counter (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation`) discards a result whose generation is stale by the time it resolves.
- `EntriesSearchBar` (new, `presentation/widgets/`): paper-elevated (`colorSurfaceElevated` fill, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`), `Icons.search` convention-equivalent not required (prototype shows no leading icon, just hint text "Buscar nos registros..."), trailing `Icons.filter_list` `IconButton` (44pt tap target, reuses `insertionModalTapTargetMin`) wired to a no-op for this story (filters are 5.2's scope) — never submitted by a button, `onChanged` feeds `cubit.onQueryChanged` directly.
- `MeusRegistrosScreen`: dock `EntriesSearchBar` under the header, above the list; when `EntriesSearchCubit.state` is not `ResourceIdle`, render search results (own skeleton-after-300ms threshold mirroring `_skeletonTimer`/`_showSkeleton`) instead of `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s timeline; `ResourceIdle` shows the existing timeline unchanged.
- Register `EntriesSearchCubit` in `entries_injection.dart` as `lazySingleton` (`dispose: cubit.close()`), same shape as `MeusRegistrosCubit`; add the matching `sl<EntriesSearchCubit>()` resolution assertions to `bootstrap_integration_test.dart`.

**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and AC1–AC4.

**Never:** a `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` param on `search()` (5.2's scope); a second `Entry`/DTO model for search results; a cache-read fallback for search; a functional filter sheet behind the funnel icon; an update/delete method anywhere on `EntriesRepository`.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Semantic match | query "ansiedade" | results include an entry only containing "nervosismo" | N/A |
| Rapid typing | 5 keystrokes within 300ms | exactly one `entries-search` call fires, for the final value | N/A |
| Query cleared | non-empty → empty/whitespace | pending timer cancelled, state → `ResourceIdle`, timeline shown, no request | N/A |
| Offline | any non-empty query, no connectivity | `ApiClient` → `Failure.networkOffline`, no cache fallback | `ResourceError(networkOffline)` rendered |
| Stale response | query A in flight, query B supersedes it | A's result discarded on arrival (generation mismatch) | N/A |
| Slow request | request exceeds 300ms | loading indicator appears | N/A — faster responses show none |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` — add `search(String query)`; update stale "third and last method ... forever" doc comment (AD-11 is create+read-only, not method-count-capped).
- `lib/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart:54-76` — mirror `list()`'s try/catch + `malformedResponse` pattern for `search()`.
- `lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart:54-94` — mirror `list()`'s persist-then-return; no fallback branch.
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/meus_registros_cubit.dart:48-57` — `_generation` pattern to mirror in the new cubit.
- `lib/core/resource.dart` — existing `Resource<T>`; first real consumer.
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart:117-153` — wire the two cubits via nested `BlocBuilder`s.
- `lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart:54-60` — registration pattern to mirror.
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` — reuse `colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`, `spacingMd/Lg`, `textBodyMd`, `insertionModalTapTargetMin`; no new token needed.
- `test/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source_test.dart`, `test/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl_test.dart`, `test/features/entries/presentation/cubit/meus_registros_cubit_test.dart` — mocktail patterns to mirror.
- `test/core/di/bootstrap_integration_test.dart:196-197` — assertion shape to replicate for `EntriesSearchCubit`.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` -- add `search()` to the port -- AC1
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- add `search()` calling `entries-search` -- AC1
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `search()`, persist-then-return, no fallback -- AC1, AC4
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart` (new) -- debounce + generation guard over `Resource<List<Entry>>` -- AC2, AC4
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart` (new) -- docked input, funnel icon, no submit button -- AC3
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` -- dock bar, branch render on search state -- AC3
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart` -- register `EntriesSearchCubit` -- supports all ACs
- [ ] `test/core/di/bootstrap_integration_test.dart` -- assert `EntriesSearchCubit` resolves -- regression guard
- [ ] Unit tests for every I/O Matrix row across the new cubit/data-source/repository files

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given a query "ansiedade", when results return, then they include an entry that only used "nervosismo" (semantic, not literal match).
- Given a user typing, when each keystroke lands, then the request is debounced 300ms — no request fires per keystroke.
- Given the search bar, when it renders, then it is permanently docked at the top of Meus Registros with a trailing funnel icon and is never submitted via a button.
- Given the user is offline, when a search is attempted, then it resolves to `Failure.networkOffline` immediately, never served from cache.

## Design Notes

`EntriesSearchCubit` is intentionally a sibling to `MeusRegistrosCubit`, not a merge into it — same reasoning `EntryDetailCubit`'s own doc already states ("never imports/reaches into `MeusRegistrosCubit` or any other Cubit"): each cubit owns exactly one fetch lifecycle, combined only at the screen's `build()`. The screen holds both cubits via `BlocProvider.value` (both already `lazySingleton`s resolved from `sl` by the router/DI, same as today's single-cubit wiring).

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Meus Registros has no way to find an Entry by meaning — a user who phrased a thought differently than how they search for it today finds nothing, and there is no search surface on the screen at all yet.

**Approach:** Add a permanently-docked search bar to Meus Registros, backed by a new `EntriesSearchCubit` (first real `Resource<T>` consumer) that debounces input 300ms and calls a new `EntriesRepository.search()` method against `entries-search`; an empty query reverts to the normal timeline, and offline resolves immediately to `Failure.networkOffline` with no cache fallback.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `EntriesRepository.search(String query)` → `Either<Failure, List<Entry>>`; `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search(String query)` calls `ApiClient.get('entries-search', queryParameters: {'q': query})` — no `limit`/`cursor` (contract has none), decodes `json['data']` with the existing `EntryDto.fromJson` (superset DTO; the response's extra `similarity`/`mode` fields are simply never read, same as other superset fields already dropped at `_toEntry`).
- `search()` is only ever called with a non-empty, already-trimmed query — `EntriesSearchCubit` owns that guarantee; the repository/data source never re-validates.
- On success, persist each returned `EntryDto` to the `entries` Hive box via `_toEntry`'s existing "persist then return" convention (`putAll`, mirrors `list()`). On any `Failure` — including `networkOffline`/`networkTimeout` — return `Left` unmapped; **no** cache-fallback branch (AD-9 carve-out: search has no client-side vector index).
- `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`, starts `ResourceIdle()`. `onQueryChanged(String raw)`: cancel any pending debounce `Timer`; if `raw.trim()` is empty, cancel and emit `ResourceIdle()` synchronously (no request); else restart a 300ms `Timer` that emits `ResourceLoading()` then awaits `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` counter (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation`) discards a result whose generation is stale by the time it resolves.
- `EntriesSearchBar` (new, `presentation/widgets/`): paper-elevated (`colorSurfaceElevated` fill, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`), `Icons.search` convention-equivalent not required (prototype shows no leading icon, just hint text "Buscar nos registros..."), trailing `Icons.filter_list` `IconButton` (44pt tap target, reuses `insertionModalTapTargetMin`) wired to a no-op for this story (filters are 5.2's scope) — never submitted by a button, `onChanged` feeds `cubit.onQueryChanged` directly.
- `MeusRegistrosScreen`: dock `EntriesSearchBar` under the header, above the list; when `EntriesSearchCubit.state` is not `ResourceIdle`, render search results (own skeleton-after-300ms threshold mirroring `_skeletonTimer`/`_showSkeleton`) instead of `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s timeline; `ResourceIdle` shows the existing timeline unchanged.
- Register `EntriesSearchCubit` in `entries_injection.dart` as `lazySingleton` (`dispose: cubit.close()`), same shape as `MeusRegistrosCubit`; add the matching `sl<EntriesSearchCubit>()` resolution assertions to `bootstrap_integration_test.dart`.

**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and AC1–AC4.

**Never:** a `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` param on `search()` (5.2's scope); a second `Entry`/DTO model for search results; a cache-read fallback for search; a functional filter sheet behind the funnel icon; an update/delete method anywhere on `EntriesRepository`.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Semantic match | query "ansiedade" | results include an entry only containing "nervosismo" | N/A |
| Rapid typing | 5 keystrokes within 300ms | exactly one `entries-search` call fires, for the final value | N/A |
| Query cleared | non-empty → empty/whitespace | pending timer cancelled, state → `ResourceIdle`, timeline shown, no request | N/A |
| Offline | any non-empty query, no connectivity | `ApiClient` → `Failure.networkOffline`, no cache fallback | `ResourceError(networkOffline)` rendered |
| Stale response | query A in flight, query B supersedes it | A's result discarded on arrival (generation mismatch) | N/A |
| Slow request | request exceeds 300ms | loading indicator appears | N/A — faster responses show none |

title: 'Semantic Search with Debounced Input'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Meus Registros has no way to find an Entry by meaning — a user who phrased a thought differently than how they search for it today finds nothing, and there is no search surface on the screen at all yet.

**Approach:** Add a permanently-docked search bar to Meus Registros, backed by a new `EntriesSearchCubit` (first real `Resource<T>` consumer) that debounces input 300ms and calls a new `EntriesRepository.search()` method against `entries-search`; an empty query reverts to the normal timeline, and offline resolves immediately to `Failure.networkOffline` with no cache fallback.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `EntriesRepository.search(String query)` → `Either<Failure, List<Entry>>`. `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` calls `ApiClient.get('entries-search', queryParameters: {'q': query})` (no `limit`/`cursor`), decodes `json['data']` with existing `EntryDto.fromJson`; extra `similarity`/`mode` fields are never read, same as other superset fields `_toEntry` already drops.
- `search()` is only called with a non-empty, pre-trimmed query — the cubit owns that guarantee, never the repository.
- On success, persist via `_toEntry`'s "persist then return" (`putAll`, mirrors `list()`). On any `Failure`, return `Left` unmapped — no cache fallback (AD-9: no client-side vector index).
- New `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`, starts `ResourceIdle()`. `onQueryChanged(raw)`: cancel pending debounce `Timer`; empty-after-trim → emit `ResourceIdle()`, no request; else restart a 300ms `Timer` → `ResourceLoading()` → `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` counter (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation`) discards stale results.
- New `EntriesSearchBar` widget: paper-elevated (`colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`), hint "Buscar nos registros...", trailing `Icons.filter_list` button (44pt, reuses `insertionModalTapTargetMin`) wired as a no-op this story (filters are 5.2); never submitted by a button — `onChanged` feeds `cubit.onQueryChanged` directly.
- `MeusRegistrosScreen`: dock the bar above the list; non-`ResourceIdle` search state renders search results (own 300ms skeleton threshold, mirrors `_skeletonTimer`) in place of the timeline; `ResourceIdle` shows the timeline unchanged.
- Register `EntriesSearchCubit` in `entries_injection.dart` as `lazySingleton` (`dispose: cubit.close()`), mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`; add matching `sl<EntriesSearchCubit>()` assertions to `bootstrap_integration_test.dart`.

**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and AC1–AC4.

**Never:** `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` params on `search()` (5.2); a second `Entry`/DTO model; a cache-read fallback for search; a functional filter sheet; an update/delete method on `EntriesRepository`.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Semantic match | query "ansiedade" | results include an entry only containing "nervosismo" | N/A |
| Rapid typing | 5 keystrokes within 300ms | exactly one `entries-search` call fires, for the final value | N/A |
| Query cleared | non-empty → empty/whitespace | pending timer cancelled, state → `ResourceIdle`, timeline shown, no request | N/A |
| Offline | any non-empty query, no connectivity | `ApiClient` → `Failure.networkOffline`, no cache fallback | `ResourceError(networkOffline)` rendered |
| Stale response | query A in flight, query B supersedes it | A's result discarded on arrival (generation mismatch) | N/A |
| Slow request | request exceeds 300ms | loading indicator appears | N/A — faster responses show none |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` — add `search()`; update stale "third and last method ... forever" comment (AD-11 is create+read-only, not method-count-capped).
- `lib/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart:54-76` — `list()`'s try/catch + `malformedResponse` pattern to mirror.
- `lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart:54-94` — `list()`'s persist-then-return to mirror; no fallback branch here.
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/meus_registros_cubit.dart:48-57` — `_generation` pattern to mirror.
- `lib/core/resource.dart` — existing `Resource<T>`; first real consumer.
- `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart:117-153` — wire both cubits via nested `BlocBuilder`s.
- `lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart:54-60` — registration pattern to mirror.
- `lib/core/design_tokens.dart` — reuse `colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`, `spacingMd/Lg`, `textBodyMd`, `insertionModalTapTargetMin`; no new token needed.
- `test/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source_test.dart`, `.../data/repositories/entries_repository_impl_test.dart`, `.../presentation/cubit/meus_registros_cubit_test.dart` — mocktail patterns to mirror.
- `test/core/di/bootstrap_integration_test.dart:196-197` — assertion shape to replicate.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` -- add `search()` to the port -- AC1
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- add `search()` calling `entries-search` -- AC1
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `search()`, persist-then-return, no fallback -- AC1, AC4
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart` (new) -- debounce + generation guard over `Resource<List<Entry>>` -- AC2, AC4
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart` (new) -- docked input, funnel icon, no submit button -- AC3
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` -- dock bar, branch render on search state -- AC3
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart` -- register `EntriesSearchCubit` -- supports all ACs
- [ ] `test/core/di/bootstrap_integration_test.dart` -- assert `EntriesSearchCubit` resolves -- regression guard
- [ ] Unit tests for every I/O Matrix row across the new cubit/data-source/repository files

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given a query "ansiedade", when results return, then they include an entry that only used "nervosismo" (semantic, not literal match).
- Given a user typing, when each keystroke lands, then the request is debounced 300ms — no request fires per keystroke.
- Given the search bar, when it renders, then it is permanently docked at the top of Meus Registros with a trailing funnel icon and is never submitted via a button.
- Given the user is offline, when a search is attempted, then it resolves to `Failure.networkOffline` immediately, never served from cache.

## Design Notes

`EntriesSearchCubit` is a sibling to `MeusRegistrosCubit`, not a merge — same reasoning `EntryDetailCubit` already follows ("never imports/reaches into `MeusRegistrosCubit` or any other Cubit"): one fetch lifecycle per cubit, combined only at the screen's `build()` via two `BlocProvider.value`s.

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass

## Intent

**Problem:** Meus Registros has no way to find an Entry by meaning — a user who phrased a thought differently than how they search for it today finds nothing, and there is no search surface on the screen at all yet.

- `search()` is only called with a non-empty, pre-trimmed query — the cubit owns that guarantee, never the repository.
- On success, persist via `_toEntry`'s "persist then return" (`putAll`, mirrors `list()`). On any `Failure`, return `Left` unmapped — no cache fallback (AD-9: no client-side vector index).
- New `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`, starts `ResourceIdle()`. `onQueryChanged(raw)`: cancel pending debounce `Timer`; empty-after-trim → emit `ResourceIdle()`, no request; else restart a 300ms `Timer` → `ResourceLoading()` → `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` counter (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation`) discards stale results.
- New `EntriesSearchBar` widget: paper-elevated (`colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`), hint "Buscar nos registros...", trailing `Icons.filter_list` button (44pt, reuses `insertionModalTapTargetMin`) wired as a no-op this story (filters are 5.2); never submitted by a button — `onChanged` feeds `cubit.onQueryChanged` directly.
- `MeusRegistrosScreen`: dock the bar above the list; non-`ResourceIdle` search state renders search results (own 300ms skeleton threshold, mirrors `_skeletonTimer`) in place of the timeline; `ResourceIdle` shows the timeline unchanged.
- Register `EntriesSearchCubit` in `entries_injection.dart` as `lazySingleton` (`dispose: cubit.close()`), mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`; add matching `sl<EntriesSearchCubit>()` assertions to `bootstrap_integration_test.dart`.

**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and AC1–AC4.

**Never:** `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` params on `search()` (5.2); a second `Entry`/DTO model; a cache-read fallback for search; a functional filter sheet; an update/delete method on `EntriesRepository`.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Semantic match | query "ansiedade" | results include an entry only containing "nervosismo" | N/A |
| Rapid typing | 5 keystrokes within 300ms | exactly one `entries-search` call fires, for the final value | N/A |
| Query cleared | non-empty → empty/whitespace | pending timer cancelled, state → `ResourceIdle`, timeline shown, no request | N/A |
| Offline | any non-empty query, no connectivity | `ApiClient` → `Failure.networkOffline`, no cache fallback | `ResourceError(networkOffline)` rendered |
| Stale response | query A in flight, query B supersedes it | A's result discarded on arrival (generation mismatch) | N/A |
| Slow request | request exceeds 300ms | loading indicator appears | N/A — faster responses show none |

- `lib/core/resource.dart` — existing `Resource<T>`; first real consumer.

- `lib/features/entries/entries_injection.dart:54-60` — registration pattern to mirror.

- `test/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source_test.dart`, `.../data/repositories/entries_repository_impl_test.dart`, `.../presentation/cubit/meus_registros_cubit_test.dart` — mocktail patterns to mirror.
- `test/core/di/bootstrap_integration_test.dart:196-197` — assertion shape to replicate.

**Execution:**
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart` -- add `search()` to the port -- AC1
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- add `search()` calling `entries-search` -- AC1

- [ ] `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart` (new) -- docked input, funnel icon, no submit button -- AC3
- [ ] `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` -- dock bar, branch render on search state -- AC3

- [ ] `test/core/di/bootstrap_integration_test.dart` -- assert `EntriesSearchCubit` resolves -- regression guard
- [ ] Unit tests for every I/O Matrix row across the new cubit/data-source/repository files

**Approach:** Add a permanently-docked search bar to Meus Registros, backed by a new `EntriesSearchCubit` (first real `Resource<T>` consumer) that debounces input 300ms and calls a new `EntriesRepository.search()` method against `entries-search`; an empty query reverts to the normal timeline, and offline resolves immediately to `Failure.networkOffline` with no cache fallback.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `EntriesRepository.search(String query)` → `Either<Failure, List<Entry>>`. `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` calls `ApiClient.get('entries-search', queryParameters: {'q': query})` (no `limit`/`cursor`), decodes `json['data']` with existing `EntryDto.fromJson`; extra `similarity`/`mode` fields are never read, same as other superset fields `_toEntry` already drops.
- `search()` is only called with a non-empty, pre-trimmed query — the cubit owns that guarantee, never the repository.
- On success, persist via `_toEntry`'s "persist then return" (`putAll`, mirrors `list()`). On any `Failure`, return `Left` unmapped — no cache fallback (AD-9: no client-side vector index).
- New `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`, starts `ResourceIdle()`. `onQueryChanged(raw)`: cancel pending debounce `Timer`; empty-after-trim → emit `ResourceIdle()`, no request; else restart a 300ms `Timer` → `ResourceLoading()` → `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` counter (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation`) discards stale results.
- New `EntriesSearchBar` widget: paper-elevated (`colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`), hint "Buscar nos registros...", trailing `Icons.filter_list` button (44pt, reuses `insertionModalTapTargetMin`) wired as a no-op this story (filters are 5.2); never submitted by a button — `onChanged` feeds `cubit.onQueryChanged` directly.
- `MeusRegistrosScreen`: dock the bar above the list; non-`ResourceIdle` search state renders search results (own 300ms skeleton threshold, mirrors `_skeletonTimer`) in place of the timeline; `ResourceIdle` shows the timeline unchanged.

  - `lib/features/entries/data/datasources/entries_remote_data_source.dart` — added `search()`: `ApiClient.get('entries-search', queryParameters: {'q': query})`, decodes `json['data']` via the existing `EntryDto.fromJson` (list-shaped response, no `limit`/`cursor`).
  - `lib/features/entries/data/repositories/entries_repository_impl.dart` — added `search()`: on success, `putAll`s every entry to the `entries` Hive box then returns `Right`; on any `Failure` (including `networkOffline`), returns `Left` unmapped — no offline/timeout cache fallback, per AD-9.
  
  **New presentation layer:**
  - `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart` (new) — `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`. `onQueryChanged(raw)` cancels the pending `Timer`, trims, and either emits `ResourceIdle` immediately (bumping `_generation` so an in-flight stale call is discarded too) or restarts a 300ms debounce `Timer` → `ResourceLoading` → `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` guard (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`) discards stale results.
  - `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart` (new) — paper-elevated bar (`colorSurfaceElevated`/`radiusMd`/`elevation1`), hint "Buscar nos registros...", trailing 44pt `Icons.filter_list` no-op button, no submit affordance — `onChanged` feeds the cubit directly.
  
  **Screen wiring:**
  - `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` — `MeusRegistrosScreen` now takes a required `searchCubit`; docks `EntriesSearchBar` above the list; a `BlocConsumer<EntriesSearchCubit, Resource<List<Entry>>>` renders the pre-existing timeline only on `ResourceIdle`, otherwise renders a new `_SearchResults` surface (own 300ms skeleton timer mirroring `_skeletonTimer`, a flat `EntryRecordCard` list with `SyncBadgeState.synchronized()` — search results are always server-confirmed, so no `deriveSyncBadgeState()` recomputation — plus minimal empty/error states).
  
  **DI + bootstrap:**
  - `entries_injection.dart` registers `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton` (`dispose: cubit.close()`), mirroring `MeusRegistrosCubit`.
  - `app_router.dart` passes `sl<EntriesSearchCubit>()` into the route.
  - `bootstrap_integration_test.dart` asserts it resolves.
  
  **Test-suite ripple (every `implements EntriesRepository` fake needed a `search()` override since it's a new abstract method):** updated fakes in `entries_repository_impl_test.dart`, `entries_remote_data_source_test.dart` (new `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search` group), `meus_registros_cubit_test.dart`, `entry_detail_cubit_test.dart`, `entry_detail_screen_test.dart`, `app_router_test.dart` (also registered a trivial `EntriesSearchCubit` into `sl` there), `pending_entry_write_tracker_test.dart`. Updated all 6 `MeusRegistrosScreen(cubit: ...)` construction sites in `meus_registros_screen_test.dart` to also pass `searchCubit`, plus added a `spec-5-1: docked search bar` test group there (bar renders; typing shows results in place of the timeline; clearing reverts; offline failure renders its message).
  
  **New tests:**
  - `test/features/entries/presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit_test.dart` — every I/O-matrix row: semantic-match shape, rapid-typing coalescing to one call, query-cleared/no-request, offline → `ResourceError`, stale-response discarding (both "query B supersedes A" and "cleared while A in-flight"), close()-while-in-flight safety. No `bloc_test` — this stack deliberately doesn't pin it (per `auth_cubit_test.dart`'s own doc), so I used the same `cubit.stream.listen` collection helper that file documents.
  - `test/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar_test.dart` — hint text, funnel icon present/no `Icons.search`, `onChanged` wired with raw (untrimmed) text, no `onSubmitted`, funnel tap is a no-op.
  - `test/features/entries/entries_search_flow_e2e_test.dart` (new) — happy path (real `entries-search` GET with `{q: ...}`, persists to real Hive box) + offline (genuinely retries `maxRetries` times via the real `RetryInterceptor`, then `Left` unmapped, pre-existing cache untouched) — driven directly against `sl<EntriesRepository>().search()`, same tier/rationale `entry_detail_flow_e2e_test.dart` used for `getById`.
  
  ## Verification
  - `fvm flutter pub get` — resolved clean.
  - `fvm flutter analyze` — **No issues found!**
  - `fvm flutter test` — **All 752 tests passed**, exit code 0 (ran full suite, then re-ran every new/touched file individually to confirm, including the new e2e file standalone).
  - No `build_runner` run needed — no `@freezed`/`@JsonSerializable` models changed.
  
  ## Known limitation (flagged, not fixed — out of spec's stated scope)
  `EntriesSearchCubit` is a `lazySingleton` per the spec's explicit instruction, but `EntriesSearchBar`'s `TextField` has no controller tied to it. If a user searches, leaves "Meus Registros", and re-enters, the cubit's `Resource` state survives (e.g. still `ResourceData`) and the search-results view renders again, but the text field itself renders empty (fresh `StatefulWidget`). This mirrors exactly what the Boundaries/Code Map specify ("mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s lazySingleton") and the I/O matrix never exercises re-entry, so I implemented it as specified rather than inventing an unspecified controller/seed mechanism — worth a look if this UX gap matters to the product owner.
  
  Files touched are listed above by path; nothing under `docs/input/` or the backend was touched, and no visual value was hardcoded outside `design_tokens.dart`.
</agent-message>

  **New presentation layer:**
  - `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart` (new) — `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`. `onQueryChanged(raw)` cancels the pending `Timer`, trims, and either emits `ResourceIdle` immediately (bumping `_generation` so an in-flight stale call is discarded too) or restarts a 300ms debounce `Timer` → `ResourceLoading` → `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` guard (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`) discards stale results.
  - `lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart` (new) — paper-elevated bar (`colorSurfaceElevated`/`radiusMd`/`elevation1`), hint "Buscar nos registros...", trailing 44pt `Icons.filter_list` no-op button, no submit affordance — `onChanged` feeds the cubit directly.
  
  **Screen wiring:**
  - `lib/features/entries/presentation/screens/meus_registros_screen.dart` — `MeusRegistrosScreen` now takes a required `searchCubit`; docks `EntriesSearchBar` above the list; a `BlocConsumer<EntriesSearchCubit, Resource<List<Entry>>>` renders the pre-existing timeline only on `ResourceIdle`, otherwise renders a new `_SearchResults` surface (own 300ms skeleton timer mirroring `_skeletonTimer`, a flat `EntryRecordCard` list with `SyncBadgeState.synchronized()` — search results are always server-confirmed, so no `deriveSyncBadgeState()` recomputation — plus minimal empty/error states).

  - `entries_injection.dart` registers `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton` (`dispose: cubit.close()`), mirroring `MeusRegistrosCubit`.
  - `app_router.dart` passes `sl<EntriesSearchCubit>()` into the route.
  - `bootstrap_integration_test.dart` asserts it resolves.

  - `test/features/entries/presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit_test.dart` — every I/O-matrix row: semantic-match shape, rapid-typing coalescing to one call, query-cleared/no-request, offline → `ResourceError`, stale-response discarding (both "query B supersedes A" and "cleared while A in-flight"), close()-while-in-flight safety. No `bloc_test` — this stack deliberately doesn't pin it (per `auth_cubit_test.dart`'s own doc), so I used the same `cubit.stream.listen` collection helper that file documents.
  - `test/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar_test.dart` — hint text, funnel icon present/no `Icons.search`, `onChanged` wired with raw (untrimmed) text, no `onSubmitted`, funnel tap is a no-op.
  - `test/features/entries/entries_search_flow_e2e_test.dart` (new) — happy path (real `entries-search` GET with `{q: ...}`, persists to real Hive box) + offline (genuinely retries `maxRetries` times via the real `RetryInterceptor`, then `Left` unmapped, pre-existing cache untouched) — driven directly against `sl<EntriesRepository>().search()`, same tier/rationale `entry_detail_flow_e2e_test.dart` used for `getById`.
  
  ## Verification
  - `fvm flutter pub get` — resolved clean.
  - `fvm flutter analyze` — **No issues found!**
  - `fvm flutter test` — **All 752 tests passed**, exit code 0 (ran full suite, then re-ran every new/touched file individually to confirm, including the new e2e file standalone).
  - No `build_runner` run needed — no `@freezed`/`@JsonSerializable` models changed.
  
  ## Known limitation (flagged, not fixed — out of spec's stated scope)
  `EntriesSearchCubit` is a `lazySingleton` per the spec's explicit instruction, but `EntriesSearchBar`'s `TextField` has no controller tied to it. If a user searches, leaves "Meus Registros", and re-enters, the cubit's `Resource` state survives (e.g. still `ResourceData`) and the search-results view renders again, but the text field itself renders empty (fresh `StatefulWidget`). This mirrors exactly what the Boundaries/Code Map specify ("mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s lazySingleton") and the I/O matrix never exercises re-entry, so I implemented it as specified rather than inventing an unspecified controller/seed mechanism — worth a look if this UX gap matters to the product owner.

166:- UX-DR20: WCAG AA adopted as the accessibility floor (not mandated by requirements.md, adopted here); every currently color-only state (sync badge dot, bookmark states) also carries an icon or accessible label — color alone never carries state.
167:- UX-DR21: Screen-reader labels announce transitions, not just static state ("Gravando," "Transcrevendo," "Erro ao transcrever, toque para tentar novamente").
168:- UX-DR22: Dynamic type honored at every level; no control truncates/clips at the largest accessibility text size — PIN keypad, filter chips, and tab bar are the tightest-fit surfaces and must be verified first.
169:- UX-DR23: Tap targets ≥44pt, including the bookmark icon and the sync-badge dot's retry hit area (visually a small dot, hit area larger).
170:- UX-DR24: Reduce Motion support — skip the streaming cursor blink and `scrimIn`/`sheetUp` easing (show final state immediately); spinners become a static "carregando" label instead of a spin animation.
171:- UX-DR25: Session-expired and account-deletion dialogs trap focus until dismissed or actioned — no interacting with scrim-covered content underneath.
175:- UX-DR26: Insertion-modal tab-switch mid-capture cancels the in-flight capture outright (recording or OCR/transcription processing) — no partial entry created; opening the modal always resets all three tabs to idle/empty. Resolves PRD OQ-3.
176:- UX-DR27: Entrance choreography limited to exactly two animations system-wide: `sheetUp` (0.2s, bottom sheets) and `scrimIn` (0.18s, any overlay's scrim) — no other motion.
177:- UX-DR28: Banned gestures enforced everywhere: no swipe-to-delete (or any swipe) on record cards, no nested overlays (a sheet opening another sheet), no pull-to-refresh beyond the spec-defined refresh points, no long-press repurposed beyond native text selection.
178:- UX-DR29: Search bar query text + active filter chips combine with AND logic against the same `GET /entries/search` call; clearing filters returns to the unfiltered list without re-mounting the screen. Resolves PRD OQ-7.

title: 'Semantic Search with Debounced Input'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'in-progress'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: '6f6a672b3a7aa50b5b65f839796586ed2b490122'

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Meus Registros has no way to find an Entry by meaning — a user who phrased a thought differently than how they search for it today finds nothing, and there is no search surface on the screen at all yet.

**Approach:** Add a permanently-docked search bar to Meus Registros, backed by a new `EntriesSearchCubit` (first real `Resource<T>` consumer) that debounces input 300ms and calls a new `EntriesRepository.search()` method against `entries-search`; an empty query reverts to the normal timeline, and offline resolves immediately to `Failure.networkOffline` with no cache fallback.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `EntriesRepository.search(String query)` → `Either<Failure, List<Entry>>`. `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` calls `ApiClient.get('entries-search', queryParameters: {'q': query})` (no `limit`/`cursor`), decodes `json['data']` with existing `EntryDto.fromJson`; extra `similarity`/`mode` fields are never read, same as other superset fields `_toEntry` already drops.
- `search()` is only called with a non-empty, pre-trimmed query — the cubit owns that guarantee, never the repository.
- On success, persist via `_toEntry`'s "persist then return" (`putAll`, mirrors `list()`). On any `Failure`, return `Left` unmapped — no cache fallback (AD-9: no client-side vector index).
- New `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`, starts `ResourceIdle()`. `onQueryChanged(raw)`: cancel pending debounce `Timer`; empty-after-trim → emit `ResourceIdle()`, no request; else restart a 300ms `Timer` → `ResourceLoading()` → `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` counter (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation`) discards stale results.
- New `EntriesSearchBar` widget: paper-elevated (`colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`), hint "Buscar nos registros...", trailing `Icons.filter_list` button (44pt, reuses `insertionModalTapTargetMin`) wired as a no-op this story (filters are 5.2); never submitted by a button — `onChanged` feeds `cubit.onQueryChanged` directly.
- `MeusRegistrosScreen`: dock the bar above the list; non-`ResourceIdle` search state renders search results (own 300ms skeleton threshold, mirrors `_skeletonTimer`) in place of the timeline; `ResourceIdle` shows the timeline unchanged.
- Register `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton` (`dispose: cubit.close()`) in `entries_injection.dart`, mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`; add its resolution assertion to `bootstrap_integration_test.dart`.

**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and the ACs below.

**Never:** `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` params on `search()` (5.2); a second `Entry`/DTO model; a cache fallback for search; a functional filter sheet; an update/delete method on `EntriesRepository`.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Semantic match | query "ansiedade" | results include an entry only containing "nervosismo" | N/A |
| Rapid typing | 5 keystrokes within 300ms | exactly one `entries-search` call fires, for the final value | N/A |
| Query cleared | non-empty → empty/whitespace | pending timer cancelled, state → `ResourceIdle`, timeline shown, no request | N/A |
| Offline | any non-empty query, no connectivity | `ApiClient` → `Failure.networkOffline`, no cache fallback | `ResourceError(networkOffline)` rendered |
| Stale response | query A in flight, query B supersedes it | A's result discarded on arrival (generation mismatch) | N/A |
| Slow request | request exceeds 300ms | loading indicator appears | N/A — faster responses show none |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `entries_repository.dart` — add `search()`; fix stale "third and last method ... forever" comment (AD-11 is create+read-only, not count-capped).
- `entries_remote_data_source.dart:54-76` / `entries_repository_impl.dart:54-94` — `list()`'s try/catch + persist-then-return pattern to mirror; `search()` has no fallback branch.
- `meus_registros_cubit.dart:48-57` — `_generation` staleness-guard pattern to mirror.
- `lib/core/resource.dart` — existing `Resource<T>`; first real consumer.
- `meus_registros_screen.dart:117-153` — wire both cubits via nested `BlocBuilder`s.
- `entries_injection.dart:54-60`, `bootstrap_integration_test.dart:196-197` — DI registration + assertion patterns to mirror.
- `design_tokens.dart` — reuse `colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`, `spacingMd/Lg`, `textBodyMd`, `insertionModalTapTargetMin`; no new token.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**

- [ ] `entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- add `search()` calling `entries-search`
- [ ] `entries_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `search()`: persist-then-return, no fallback
- [ ] `presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart` (new) -- debounce + generation guard over `Resource<List<Entry>>`
- [ ] `presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart` (new) -- docked input, funnel icon, no submit button
- [ ] `meus_registros_screen.dart` -- dock bar; branch render on search state
- [ ] `entries_injection.dart` -- register `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton`
- [ ] `bootstrap_integration_test.dart` -- assert `EntriesSearchCubit` resolves
- [ ] Unit tests covering every I/O Matrix row across the new/changed files
- [ ] `test/features/entries/entries_search_flow_e2e_test.dart` (new) -- happy-path + offline; new real-pipeline surface, same rationale spec-4-4 used for `getById`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given a query "ansiedade", when results return, then they include an entry that only used "nervosismo" (semantic, not literal match).
- Given a user typing, when each keystroke lands, then the request is debounced 300ms — no request fires per keystroke.
- Given the search bar, when it renders, then it is permanently docked at the top of Meus Registros with a trailing funnel icon and is never submitted via a button.
- Given the user is offline, when a search is attempted, then it resolves to `Failure.networkOffline` immediately, never served from cache.

- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass

---
title: 'Semantic Search with Debounced Input'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'in-progress'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: '6f6a672b3a7aa50b5b65f839796586ed2b490122'
