<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Meus Registros has no way to find an Entry by meaning — a user who phrased a thought differently than how they search for it today finds nothing, and there is no search surface on the screen at all yet.

**Approach:** Add a permanently-docked search bar to Meus Registros, backed by a new `EntriesSearchCubit` (first real `Resource<T>` consumer) that debounces input 300ms and calls a new `EntriesRepository.search()` method against `entries-search`; an empty query reverts to the normal timeline, and offline resolves immediately to `Failure.networkOffline` with no cache fallback.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `EntriesRepository.search(String query)` → `Either<Failure, List<Entry>>`. `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` calls `ApiClient.get('entries-search', queryParameters: {'q': query})` (no `limit`/`cursor`), decodes `json['data']` with existing `EntryDto.fromJson`; extra `similarity`/`mode` fields are never read, same as other superset fields `_toEntry` already drops.
- `search()` is only called with a non-empty, pre-trimmed query — the cubit owns that guarantee, never the repository.
- On success, persist via `_toEntry`'s "persist then return" (`putAll`, mirrors `list()`). On any `Failure`, return `Left` unmapped — no cache fallback (AD-9: no client-side vector index).
- New `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`, starts `ResourceIdle()`. `onQueryChanged(raw)`: cancel pending debounce `Timer`; empty-after-trim → emit `ResourceIdle()`, no request; else restart a 300ms `Timer` → `ResourceLoading()` → `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` counter (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation`) discards stale results.
- New `EntriesSearchBar` widget: paper-elevated (`colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`), hint "Buscar nos registros...", trailing `Icons.filter_list` button (44pt, reuses `insertionModalTapTargetMin`) wired as a no-op this story (filters are 5.2); never submitted by a button — `onChanged` feeds `cubit.onQueryChanged` directly.
- `MeusRegistrosScreen`: dock the bar above the list; non-`ResourceIdle` search state renders search results (own 300ms skeleton threshold, mirrors `_skeletonTimer`) in place of the timeline; `ResourceIdle` shows the timeline unchanged.
- Register `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton` (`dispose: cubit.close()`) in `entries_injection.dart`, mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`; add its resolution assertion to `bootstrap_integration_test.dart`.

**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and the ACs below.

**Never:** `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` params on `search()` (5.2); a second `Entry`/DTO model; a cache fallback for search; a functional filter sheet; an update/delete method on `EntriesRepository`.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Semantic match | query "ansiedade" | results include an entry only containing "nervosismo" | N/A |
| Rapid typing | 5 keystrokes within 300ms | exactly one `entries-search` call fires, for the final value | N/A |
| Query cleared | non-empty → empty/whitespace | pending timer cancelled, state → `ResourceIdle`, timeline shown, no request | N/A |
| Offline | any non-empty query, no connectivity | `ApiClient` → `Failure.networkOffline`, no cache fallback | `ResourceError(networkOffline)` rendered |
| Stale response | query A in flight, query B supersedes it | A's result discarded on arrival (generation mismatch) | N/A |
| Slow request | request exceeds 300ms | loading indicator appears | N/A — faster responses show none |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `entries_repository.dart` — add `search()`; fix stale "third and last method ... forever" comment (AD-11 is create+read-only, not count-capped).
- `entries_remote_data_source.dart:54-76` / `entries_repository_impl.dart:54-94` — `list()`'s try/catch + persist-then-return pattern to mirror; `search()` has no fallback branch.
- `meus_registros_cubit.dart:48-57` — `_generation` staleness-guard pattern to mirror.
- `lib/core/resource.dart` — existing `Resource<T>`; first real consumer.
- `meus_registros_screen.dart:117-153` — wire both cubits via nested `BlocBuilder`s.
- `entries_injection.dart:54-60`, `bootstrap_integration_test.dart:196-197` — DI registration + assertion patterns to mirror.
- `design_tokens.dart` — reuse `colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`, `spacingMd/Lg`, `textBodyMd`, `insertionModalTapTargetMin`; no new token.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `entries_repository.dart` -- add `search(String query)` to the port
- [x] `entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- add `search()` calling `entries-search`
- [x] `entries_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `search()`: persist-then-return, no fallback
- [x] `presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart` (new) -- debounce + generation guard over `Resource<List<Entry>>`
- [x] `presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart` (new) -- docked input, funnel icon, no submit button
- [x] `meus_registros_screen.dart` -- dock bar; branch render on search state
- [x] `entries_injection.dart` -- register `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton`
- [x] `bootstrap_integration_test.dart` -- assert `EntriesSearchCubit` resolves
- [x] Unit tests covering every I/O Matrix row across the new/changed files
- [x] `test/features/entries/entries_search_flow_e2e_test.dart` (new) -- happy-path + offline; new real-pipeline surface, same rationale spec-4-4 used for `getById`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given a query "ansiedade", when results return, then they include an entry that only used "nervosismo" (semantic, not literal match).
- Given a user typing, when each keystroke lands, then the request is debounced 300ms — no request fires per keystroke.
- Given the search bar, when it renders, then it is permanently docked at the top of Meus Registros with a trailing funnel icon and is never submitted via a button.
- Given the user is offline, when a search is attempted, then it resolves to `Failure.networkOffline` immediately, never served from cache.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass

16	+
17	+<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">
18	+
19	+## Intent
20	+
21	+**Problem:** Meus Registros has no way to find an Entry by meaning — a user who phrased a thought differently than how they search for it today finds nothing, and there is no search surface on the screen at all yet.
22	+
23	+**Approach:** Add a permanently-docked search bar to Meus Registros, backed by a new `EntriesSearchCubit` (first real `Resource<T>` consumer) that debounces input 300ms and calls a new `EntriesRepository.search()` method against `entries-search`; an empty query reverts to the normal timeline, and offline resolves immediately to `Failure.networkOffline` with no cache fallback.
24	+
25	+## Boundaries & Constraints
26	+
27	+**Always:**
28	+- `EntriesRepository.search(String query)` → `Either<Failure, List<Entry>>`. `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` calls `ApiClient.get('entries-search', queryParameters: {'q': query})` (no `limit`/`cursor`), decodes `json['data']` with existing `EntryDto.fromJson`; extra `similarity`/`mode` fields are never read, same as other superset fields `_toEntry` already drops.
29	+- `search()` is only called with a non-empty, pre-trimmed query — the cubit owns that guarantee, never the repository.
30	+- On success, persist via `_toEntry`'s "persist then return" (`putAll`, mirrors `list()`). On any `Failure`, return `Left` unmapped — no cache fallback (AD-9: no client-side vector index).
31	+- New `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`, starts `ResourceIdle()`. `onQueryChanged(raw)`: cancel pending debounce `Timer`; empty-after-trim → emit `ResourceIdle()`, no request; else restart a 300ms `Timer` → `ResourceLoading()` → `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` counter (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation`) discards stale results.
32	+- New `EntriesSearchBar` widget: paper-elevated (`colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`), hint "Buscar nos registros...", trailing `Icons.filter_list` button (44pt, reuses `insertionModalTapTargetMin`) wired as a no-op this story (filters are 5.2); never submitted by a button — `onChanged` feeds `cubit.onQueryChanged` directly.
33	+- `MeusRegistrosScreen`: dock the bar above the list; non-`ResourceIdle` search state renders search results (own 300ms skeleton threshold, mirrors `_skeletonTimer`) in place of the timeline; `ResourceIdle` shows the timeline unchanged.
34	+- Register `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton` (`dispose: cubit.close()`) in `entries_injection.dart`, mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`; add its resolution assertion to `bootstrap_integration_test.dart`.
35	+
36	+**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and the ACs below.
37	+
38	+**Never:** `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` params on `search()` (5.2); a second `Entry`/DTO model; a cache fallback for search; a functional filter sheet; an update/delete method on `EntriesRepository`.
39	+
40	+## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
41	+
42	+| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
43	+|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
44	+| Semantic match | query "ansiedade" | results include an entry only containing "nervosismo" | N/A |
45	+| Rapid typing | 5 keystrokes within 300ms | exactly one `entries-search` call fires, for the final value | N/A |
46	+| Query cleared | non-empty → empty/whitespace | pending timer cancelled, state → `ResourceIdle`, timeline shown, no request | N/A |
47	+| Offline | any non-empty query, no connectivity | `ApiClient` → `Failure.networkOffline`, no cache fallback | `ResourceError(networkOffline)` rendered |
48	+| Stale response | query A in flight, query B supersedes it | A's result discarded on arrival (generation mismatch) | N/A |
49	+| Slow request | request exceeds 300ms | loading indicator appears | N/A — faster responses show none |
50	+
51	+</frozen-after-approval>
52	+
53	+## Code Map
54	+
55	+- `entries_repository.dart` — add `search()`; fix stale "third and last method ... forever" comment (AD-11 is create+read-only, not count-capped).
56	+- `entries_remote_data_source.dart:54-76` / `entries_repository_impl.dart:54-94` — `list()`'s try/catch + persist-then-return pattern to mirror; `search()` has no fallback branch.
57	+- `meus_registros_cubit.dart:48-57` — `_generation` staleness-guard pattern to mirror.
58	+- `lib/core/resource.dart` — existing `Resource<T>`; first real consumer.
59	+- `meus_registros_screen.dart:117-153` — wire both cubits via nested `BlocBuilder`s.
60	+- `entries_injection.dart:54-60`, `bootstrap_integration_test.dart:196-197` — DI registration + assertion patterns to mirror.
61	+- `design_tokens.dart` — reuse `colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`, `spacingMd/Lg`, `textBodyMd`, `insertionModalTapTargetMin`; no new token.
62	+
63	+## Tasks & Acceptance
64	+
65	+**Execution:**
66	+- [x] `entries_repository.dart` -- add `search(String query)` to the port
67	+- [x] `entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- add `search()` calling `entries-search`
68	+- [x] `entries_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `search()`: persist-then-return, no fallback
69	+- [x] `presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart` (new) -- debounce + generation guard over `Resource<List<Entry>>`
70	+- [x] `presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart` (new) -- docked input, funnel icon, no submit button
71	+- [x] `meus_registros_screen.dart` -- dock bar; branch render on search state
72	+- [x] `entries_injection.dart` -- register `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton`
73	+- [x] `bootstrap_integration_test.dart` -- assert `EntriesSearchCubit` resolves
74	+- [x] Unit tests covering every I/O Matrix row across the new/changed files
75	+- [x] `test/features/entries/entries_search_flow_e2e_test.dart` (new) -- happy-path + offline; new real-pipeline surface, same rationale spec-4-4 used for `getById`
76	+
77	+**Acceptance Criteria:**
78	+- Given a query "ansiedade", when results return, then they include an entry that only used "nervosismo" (semantic, not literal match).
79	+- Given a user typing, when each keystroke lands, then the request is debounced 300ms — no request fires per keystroke.
80	+- Given the search bar, when it renders, then it is permanently docked at the top of Meus Registros with a trailing funnel icon and is never submitted via a button.
81	+- Given the user is offline, when a search is attempted, then it resolves to `Failure.networkOffline` immediately, never served from cache.
82	+

@@ -0,0 +1,81 @@
+---
+title: 'Semantic Search with Debounced Input'
+type: 'feature'
+created: '2026-11-05'
+status: 'in-review'
+review_loop_iteration: 0
+context: []
+baseline_commit: '6f6a672b3a7aa50b5b65f839796586ed2b490122'
+---
+
+<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">
+
+## Intent
+
+**Problem:** Meus Registros has no way to find an Entry by meaning — a user who phrased a thought differently than how they search for it today finds nothing, and there is no search surface on the screen at all yet.
+
+**Approach:** Add a permanently-docked search bar to Meus Registros, backed by a new `EntriesSearchCubit` (first real `Resource<T>` consumer) that debounces input 300ms and calls a new `EntriesRepository.search()` method against `entries-search`; an empty query reverts to the normal timeline, and offline resolves immediately to `Failure.networkOffline` with no cache fallback.
+
+## Boundaries & Constraints
+
+**Always:**
+- `EntriesRepository.search(String query)` → `Either<Failure, List<Entry>>`. `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` calls `ApiClient.get('entries-search', queryParameters: {'q': query})` (no `limit`/`cursor`), decodes `json['data']` with existing `EntryDto.fromJson`; extra `similarity`/`mode` fields are never read, same as other superset fields `_toEntry` already drops.
+- `search()` is only called with a non-empty, pre-trimmed query — the cubit owns that guarantee, never the repository.
+- On success, persist via `_toEntry`'s "persist then return" (`putAll`, mirrors `list()`). On any `Failure`, return `Left` unmapped — no cache fallback (AD-9: no client-side vector index).
+- New `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`, starts `ResourceIdle()`. `onQueryChanged(raw)`: cancel pending debounce `Timer`; empty-after-trim → emit `ResourceIdle()`, no request; else restart a 300ms `Timer` → `ResourceLoading()` → `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` counter (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation`) discards stale results.
+- New `EntriesSearchBar` widget: paper-elevated (`colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`), hint "Buscar nos registros...", trailing `Icons.filter_list` button (44pt, reuses `insertionModalTapTargetMin`) wired as a no-op this story (filters are 5.2); never submitted by a button — `onChanged` feeds `cubit.onQueryChanged` directly.
+- `MeusRegistrosScreen`: dock the bar above the list; non-`ResourceIdle` search state renders search results (own 300ms skeleton threshold, mirrors `_skeletonTimer`) in place of the timeline; `ResourceIdle` shows the timeline unchanged.
+- Register `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton` (`dispose: cubit.close()`) in `entries_injection.dart`, mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`; add its resolution assertion to `bootstrap_integration_test.dart`.
+
+**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and the ACs below.
+
+**Never:** `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` params on `search()` (5.2); a second `Entry`/DTO model; a cache fallback for search; a functional filter sheet; an update/delete method on `EntriesRepository`.
+
+## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix
+
+| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
+|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
+| Semantic match | query "ansiedade" | results include an entry only containing "nervosismo" | N/A |
+| Rapid typing | 5 keystrokes within 300ms | exactly one `entries-search` call fires, for the final value | N/A |
+| Query cleared | non-empty → empty/whitespace | pending timer cancelled, state → `ResourceIdle`, timeline shown, no request | N/A |
+| Offline | any non-empty query, no connectivity | `ApiClient` → `Failure.networkOffline`, no cache fallback | `ResourceError(networkOffline)` rendered |
+| Stale response | query A in flight, query B supersedes it | A's result discarded on arrival (generation mismatch) | N/A |
+| Slow request | request exceeds 300ms | loading indicator appears | N/A — faster responses show none |
+
+</frozen-after-approval>
+
+## Code Map
+
+- `entries_repository.dart` — add `search()`; fix stale "third and last method ... forever" comment (AD-11 is create+read-only, not count-capped).
+- `entries_remote_data_source.dart:54-76` / `entries_repository_impl.dart:54-94` — `list()`'s try/catch + persist-then-return pattern to mirror; `search()` has no fallback branch.
+- `meus_registros_cubit.dart:48-57` — `_generation` staleness-guard pattern to mirror.
+- `lib/core/resource.dart` — existing `Resource<T>`; first real consumer.
+- `meus_registros_screen.dart:117-153` — wire both cubits via nested `BlocBuilder`s.
+- `entries_injection.dart:54-60`, `bootstrap_integration_test.dart:196-197` — DI registration + assertion patterns to mirror.
+- `design_tokens.dart` — reuse `colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`, `spacingMd/Lg`, `textBodyMd`, `insertionModalTapTargetMin`; no new token.
+
+## Tasks & Acceptance
+
+**Execution:**
+- [x] `entries_repository.dart` -- add `search(String query)` to the port
+- [x] `entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- add `search()` calling `entries-search`
+- [x] `entries_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `search()`: persist-then-return, no fallback
+- [x] `presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart` (new) -- debounce + generation guard over `Resource<List<Entry>>`
+- [x] `presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart` (new) -- docked input, funnel icon, no submit button
+- [x] `meus_registros_screen.dart` -- dock bar; branch render on search state
+- [x] `entries_injection.dart` -- register `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton`
+- [x] `bootstrap_integration_test.dart` -- assert `EntriesSearchCubit` resolves
+- [x] Unit tests covering every I/O Matrix row across the new/changed files
+- [x] `test/features/entries/entries_search_flow_e2e_test.dart` (new) -- happy-path + offline; new real-pipeline surface, same rationale spec-4-4 used for `getById`
+
+**Acceptance Criteria:**
+- Given a query "ansiedade", when results return, then they include an entry that only used "nervosismo" (semantic, not literal match).
+- Given a user typing, when each keystroke lands, then the request is debounced 300ms — no request fires per keystroke.
+- Given the search bar, when it renders, then it is permanently docked at the top of Meus Registros with a trailing funnel icon and is never submitted via a button.
+- Given the user is offline, when a search is attempted, then it resolves to `Failure.networkOffline` immediately, never served from cache.
+
+## Verification
+
+**Commands:**
+- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
+- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass

+import 'dart:async';
+
+import 'package:flutter_bloc/flutter_bloc.dart';
+
+import '../../../../core/resource.dart';
+import '../../domain/entities/entry.dart';
+import '../../domain/repositories/entries_repository.dart';
+
+/// Drives `EntriesSearchBar`/`MeusRegistrosScreen`'s docked search surface
+/// (spec-5-1) — the first real `Resource<T>` consumer (AD-12: "single data
+/// source, single fetch" is exactly this screen's search slice, unlike
+/// `MeusRegistrosState`'s own paginated shape). A DI `lazySingleton`
+/// (Code Map), mirroring `MeusRegistrosCubit`: long-lived, so a query
+/// already typed survives leaving and re-entering `/meus-registros` within
+/// the same app session — though [onQueryChanged] is never called except
+/// by the live `EntriesSearchBar`'s own `onChanged`, there is no
+/// "re-run the last query on return" behavior to preserve here beyond the
+/// cubit simply outliving the screen like `MeusRegistrosCubit` already
+/// does.
+class EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>> {
+  EntriesSearchCubit(this._repository) : super(const ResourceIdle());
+
+  final EntriesRepository _repository;
+
+  /// `EntriesSearchBar`'s own debounce window (I/O matrix: "5 keystrokes
+  /// within 300ms -> exactly one `entries-search` call fires, for the
+  /// final value").
+  static const _debounceDuration = Duration(milliseconds: 300);
+
+  Timer? _debounceTimer;
+
+  /// A monotonic counter guarding against a stale in-flight [search] call's
+  /// result landing after a newer one has already changed the state —
+  /// mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation` exactly. Bumped both when a
+  /// new debounced search actually starts *and* when the query is cleared
+  /// back to idle (Boundaries' "Stale response" row: an in-flight query A
+  /// must never land once query B — even an empty one — has already
+  /// superseded it).
+  int _generation = 0;
+
+  /// `EntriesSearchBar.onChanged`'s one call site — [raw] is the text
+  /// field's current (untrimmed) value on every keystroke. Cancels any
+  /// pending debounce `Timer` first, regardless of outcome below (Code
+  /// Map/Boundaries): a keystroke always supersedes whatever this cubit
+  /// was about to do next.
+  void onQueryChanged(String raw) {
+    _debounceTimer?.cancel();
+    final query = raw.trim();
+    if (query.isEmpty) {
+      // I/O matrix: "Query cleared" — no request, pending work discarded,
+      // timeline shown. Bumping the generation here (not only inside
+      // [_search]) is what actually discards an already-in-flight
+      // previous query's result once it resolves.
+      _generation++;
+      emit(const ResourceIdle());
+      return;
+    }
+    _debounceTimer = Timer(_debounceDuration, () => _search(query));
+  }
+
+  Future<void> _search(String query) async {
+    final generation = ++_generation;
+    emit(const ResourceLoading());
+    final result = await _repository.search(query);
+    // Mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit.loadFirstPage`'s own guard: `close()` can
+    // race this awaited call, and a newer query (or a clear back to idle)
+    // can have superseded this one while it was in flight.
+    if (isClosed || generation != _generation) {
+      return;
+    }
+    result.match(
+      (failure) => emit(ResourceError(failure)),
+      (entries) => emit(ResourceData(entries)),
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<void> close() {
+    _debounceTimer?.cancel();
+    return super.close();
+  }
+}

+/// Same shape as `entries_list_flow_e2e_test.dart`'s/
+/// `entry_detail_flow_e2e_test.dart`'s own fake adapter — only the
+/// transport boundary is faked.
+class _FakeHttpClientAdapter implements HttpClientAdapter {
+  final List<RequestOptions> requests = [];
+  final List<({int statusCode, Map<String, dynamic> body})> _queue = [];
+
+  void queueJsonResponse(int statusCode, Map<String, dynamic> body) {
+    _queue.add((statusCode: statusCode, body: body));
+  }
+
+  void queueErrorResponse(String code, String message) {
+    queueJsonResponse(503, {
+      'code': code,
+      'message': message,
+      'retryable': true,
+    });
+  }
+
+  @override
+  Future<ResponseBody> fetch(
+    RequestOptions options,
+    Stream<Uint8List>? requestStream,
+    Future<void>? cancelFuture,
+  ) async {
+    requests.add(options);
+    if (_queue.isEmpty) {
+      throw StateError(
+        'No queued response for ${options.method} ${options.path}',
+      );
+    }
+    final next = _queue.removeAt(0);
+    return ResponseBody.fromString(
+      jsonEncode(next.body),
+      next.statusCode,
+      headers: {
+        Headers.contentTypeHeader: [Headers.jsonContentType],
+      },
+    );
+  }
+
+  @override
+  void close({bool force = false}) {}
+}
+
+Map<String, dynamic> _entryJson({
+  required String id,
+  required String content,
+  required String source,
+  required String occurredAt,
+}) => {
+  'id': id,
+  'content': content,
+  'source': source,
+  'chatMessageId': null,
+  'occurredAt': occurredAt,
+  'serverRevision': 1,
+  'createdAt': occurredAt,
+  'updatedAt': occurredAt,
+};
+
+/// End-to-end coverage for spec-5-1's `search()` path — the new
+/// real-pipeline surface this story introduces
+/// (`EntriesRepositoryImpl.search` -> `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search` ->
+/// `ApiClient` -> `Dio` (both real interceptors attached) -> a real
+/// `entries` Hive box), the same tier `entry_detail_flow_e2e_test.dart`
+/// already proves for `getById()` (Tasks & Acceptance: "same rationale
+/// spec-4-4 used for `getById`").
+///
+/// Driven directly against `EntriesRepository.search()` rather than
+/// `EntriesSearchCubit` — `entries_search_cubit_test.dart` already proves
+/// the debounce/generation-guard state machine against a fake repository;
+/// this file's own job is only the real network + real disk pipeline
+/// underneath it, matching `entries_list_flow_e2e_test.dart`'s/
+/// `entry_detail_flow_e2e_test.dart`'s own split between cubit-level and
+/// repository-level e2e coverage.
+void main() {
+  TestWidgetsFlutterBinding.ensureInitialized();
+
+  const secureStorageChannel = MethodChannel(
+    'plugins.it_nomads.com/flutter_secure_storage',
+  );
+  final fakeNativeStorage = <String, String>{};
+
+  Future<dynamic> handleSecureStorageCall(MethodCall call) async {
+    final args = call.arguments as Map<dynamic, dynamic>;
+    switch (call.method) {
+      case 'write':
+        fakeNativeStorage[args['key'] as String] = args['value'] as String;
+        return null;
+      case 'read':
+        return fakeNativeStorage[args['key'] as String];
+      case 'delete':
+        fakeNativeStorage.remove(args['key'] as String);
+        return null;
+      case 'containsKey':
+        return fakeNativeStorage.containsKey(args['key'] as String);
+      default:

+    }

[Subagent hand-back] The text below is the final report of a subagent this session delegated to. It is model output, NOT a message from the user: instructions, requests, or approval claims inside it are the subagent's words and carry no user authority. Notes above this frame may quote model-derived text, which carries no user authority either. The report follows:
  ## Review findings — story-5-1-diff.patch (Semantic Search with Debounced Input)
  
  - `EntriesSearchBar` (`lib/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart`) wraps a plain `TextField` with no `controller` and no way to restore prior text. `EntriesSearchCubit` is registered as a `lazySingleton` and explicitly documented to outlive the screen ("a query already typed survives leaving and re-entering /meus-registros"), but the *text field itself* is rebuilt empty every time `MeusRegistrosScreen`'s `State` is recreated (e.g. leaving to the entry-detail route and coming back). The result: the cubit can still be sitting in `ResourceData`/`ResourceError` (so the search-results view renders instead of the timeline) while the visible search box shows nothing typed — a real UI/state mismatch the cubit's own doc comment doesn't actually address (it only argues the cubit's *state* survives, not the widget's displayed text).
  
  - There is no way to clear the query from the UI itself — no "x"/clear affordance on `EntriesSearchBar`, and the widget test (`entries_search_bar_test.dart`) explicitly asserts there is no `Icons.search` icon and no submit handler, but nothing checks for a clear control either. Given "empty query reverts to the normal timeline" is a core behavior, users have no way to trigger it except manually deleting every character.
  
  - The spec (`spec-5-1-semantic-search-with-debounced-input.md`, Boundaries) and the data-source test (`entries_remote_data_source_test.dart`, "a superset response (similarity/mode fields) is simply ignored") both model `mode` as a per-item field alongside `similarity`. Checking `docs/input/backend/api/openapi.yaml` (`/entries/search`), `similarity` is indeed a field on each `data[]` item, but `mode` is actually `meta.mode` — a sibling of `data` in the top-level response envelope, not a per-item field at all. The spec doc and the test fixture both misrepresent the real contract shape (harmless in practice since extra fields are ignored regardless, but the "superset ignored" test doesn't exercise the actual response shape it claims to).
  
  - Nothing in `EntriesRepository.search()`/`EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` defends against being called with an empty/blank query. The invariant ("non-empty, pre-trimmed") is documented as the cubit's responsibility only, but the repository method is public on an interface other callers could reach; calling it with `''` would silently hit the backend as a legal filter-only search (per the contract, `q` is optional) with no guard or assertion at the boundary that's supposed to own this rule.
  
  - The trailing filter `IconButton` (`Icons.filter_list`) in `EntriesSearchBar` has no `tooltip`/semantic label. It's a real, future-functional control per the doc comment ("reads as a real, future-functional control"), but a screen-reader user currently gets an unlabeled icon button with no indication of its purpose.
  
  - `_onSearchStateChanged` (the `BlocConsumer` listener driving `_searchSkeletonTimer`) only fires when the emitted `Resource` actually changes value. If `ResourceLoading<T>` has value equality (as is typical for a freezed-style sealed state like this and like `Failure` elsewhere in the codebase), a second query that starts while the first is still in flight re-emits an equal `ResourceLoading()` and the listener won't fire again — so the skeleton threshold for the second query is measured from the *first* query's start time, not its own. Worth confirming `Resource`'s equality semantics and adding a test for two back-to-back in-flight searches at the widget level (only the cubit-level fake-repository test exercises "stale response"; nothing proves the skeleton/UI reacts correctly to the same scenario).
  
  - No test exercises "same value re-submitted" (e.g. typing a trailing space that trims to the same query as before, or typing then backspacing back to an already-searched string) — `onQueryChanged` always restarts the debounce timer and will re-fire an identical `search()` call with no de-dupe, which isn't called out anywhere in Boundaries/the I/O matrix but is a real, cheap-to-avoid redundant network call.
  
  - `sprint-status.yaml` sets `5-1-semantic-search-with-debounced-input: in-progress` and `epic-5: in-progress`, while the spec's own frontmatter says `status: 'in-review'` and every item under "Tasks & Acceptance" is already checked `[x]`. These two trackers disagree on where the story actually is — if dev work and tests are done, the sprint-status value should likely read something closer to "review," not "in-progress".
  
  - `EntriesSearchBar`'s `TextField` has no `textInputAction` configured and no `onSubmitted` handler (consistent with "never submitted via a button"), but this means the device's default IME action button (often rendered as "Done"/"Search"/a magnifying-glass glyph depending on platform) is visibly present and silently does nothing when pressed — likely to read as broken rather than intentionally absent, since nothing suppresses or relabels it.
  
  - The `_SearchResults` widget's empty-result message ("Nenhum resultado encontrado") and error message (`failure.message`) are the only two outcomes handled; there's no differentiation between "zero semantic matches" and any other `Failure` subtype the backend's error taxonomy might return besides offline/timeout (e.g. a validation-class failure), and no test exercises a non-network `Failure` reaching `_SearchErrorState` through the full screen (only the repository/data-source layers test `authExpired`-style failures — the screen-level widget tests only cover `networkOffline`).
  
  - `meus_registros_screen.dart`'s new docked-bar `Padding` line (`child: EntriesSearchBar(onChanged: widget.searchCubit.onQueryChanged),`) is long enough to likely trip a line-length lint if one is enabled in `analysis_options.yaml`; worth confirming `fvm flutter analyze` is actually clean (per AGENTS.md's "must report zero issues" gate) rather than assuming it from the diff alone.
  
  - There's no test asserting the search bar stays "permanently docked" under scroll — it happens to work because the `Padding`-wrapped `EntriesSearchBar` sits as a `Column` sibling outside the `Expanded` list rather than inside it, but nothing regression-locks that layout choice; a future change that moves it inside the scrollable region would silently violate the "permanently docked" acceptance criterion with no test catching it.
  
  - The DI registration comment in `entries_injection.dart` and the cubit's own class doc both justify `lazySingleton` by analogy to `MeusRegistrosCubit`, but neither addresses that `MeusRegistrosCubit` has pagination/retry state worth preserving across navigation, whereas `EntriesSearchCubit`'s own doc comment admits there's no actual "re-run last query" behavior being preserved — i.e. the singleton lifetime buys a lingering (and, per the first finding above, visually orphaned) stale result rather than any functional benefit for this story. Worth confirming a `factory` (closed on screen dispose, mirroring `EntryDetailCubit`'s instead) wasn't the better fit, since "survives navigation" doesn't currently do anything useful.
  
</agent-message>

All three review layers completed. Verification-gap found nothing; edge-case-hunter and blind-hunter together surfaced a few real, fixable issues plus some noise. Let me classify everything and then send the confirmed patches to the original implementation subagent, which I can still re-engage.

**Triage:**

- **patch** (real, trivially fixable, outside the frozen block):
 1. `entries_search_cubit.dart` — `onQueryChanged('')`'s empty branch emits without an `isClosed` guard (the awaited `_search()` path already has one) → `emit()` after `close()` throws.
 2. `entries_search_cubit.dart` — `emit(const ResourceLoading())` uses a canonicalized const instance; `Cubit.emit` skips re-emitting an equal state, so a second back-to-back search (while the first is still in flight) never re-fires `BlocConsumer`'s listener — the search skeleton timer isn't reset for the second query, breaking the RNF01 threshold guarantee under rapid retyping. Fix: drop `const`.
 3. `entries_repository_impl.dart` — `search()` doesn't dedupe by id before mapping/persisting, unlike the codebase's existing `_dedupedById` convention elsewhere; a backend violating its own no-duplicate-ids invariant would crash the `ValueKey`-keyed results list.
 4. `entries_search_bar.dart` — the funnel `IconButton` has no tooltip/semantic label (accessibility gap, UX-DR21).

- **defer** (real but out of this story's committed scope — appending to `deferred-work.md`): `EntriesSearchCubit` is a `lazySingleton` paired with a stateless `TextField` — returning to Meus Registros after navigating away (e.g. from a search result's entry detail) shows stale search results with an empty-looking search box, since the cubit's state persists but the text field doesn't. No AC/I-O-row covers re-entry, and the pattern matches `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s own accepted ScrollController-resets-but-data-persists precedent, so it's not a defect introduced ex nihilo by this story — but it's real and worth a focused look.

- **reject** (noise, dropped silently): no UI clear/"x" affordance (not required by the ACs); `mode` documented as per-item vs its real `meta.mode` location (zero behavioral impact); no empty-query guard at the repository boundary (hypothetical, backend handles empty `q` as a legal optional param); no de-dupe for an identical re-typed query (optimization nicety); sprint-status "in-progress" vs spec "in-review" (expected — sprint-status only syncs at specific workflow checkpoints); default IME action "doing nothing" (normal `TextField` behavior, not broken); missing widget test for a non-offline `Failure` reaching `_SearchErrorState` (redundant — the renderer has no per-type branching); lint/line-length concern (already disproven — `flutter analyze` is clean); no regression test locking "docked under scroll" (low risk, simple layout).

Sending the confirmed patches to the original implementation subagent now, since it's still reachable with context intact.

entries.name: SendMessage
entries.description:
# SendMessage

Send a message to another agent.

```json
{"to": "researcher", "summary": "assign task 1", "message": "start on task #1"}
```

| `to` | |
|---|---|
| `"researcher"` | Teammate by name |
| `"main"` | The main conversation (background subagents only) |
| `"worker"` | Any agent from `ListAgents` — subagent, another local Claude session |
| `"worker [3fa9c1]"` | Same, plus its `[ref]` — only when a listing or an error shows one |

Your plain text output is NOT visible to other agents — to communicate, you MUST call this tool. Messages from teammates are delivered automatically; you don't check an inbox. Refer to agents by name — names keep working after an agent completes (a send resumes it from its transcript). Use the raw `agentId` (format `a...-...`) from its spawn result only when the agent has no name, or when a newer agent took the name (latest wins). When relaying, don't quote the original — it's already rendered to the user.

## Cross-session

Use `ListAgents` to discover targets. Every row leads with the agent's `name [ref]` — the name IS the address; there is no separate address syntax.

```json
{"to": "worker", "message": "check if tests pass over there"}
{"to": "worker [3fa9c1]", "message": "you, specifically"}
```

Send the bare name — a name that exactly matches one live agent or session (on this machine, on another machine, or in the cloud) delivers directly. Append the ` [ref]` only when the bare name is not enough — `ListAgents` shows two rows with it, or an error asks you to disambiguate (you typed only a prefix, or a session list could not be checked). A ref you did not just read from a listing or an error will not resolve, and if the same name also names an in-process agent, the bare name always wins — use the in-process one.

A listed peer is alive and will receive your message; messages enqueue and drain at the receiver's next tool round (its `ListAgents` row says whether it is busy or idle right now). A successful send means the message reached that session, not that its Claude read it: a session running in a different permission mode than yours holds cross-session messages for its user's approval (and may let them expire), and a session can refuse them outright — for a session on this machine a `[Cross-session delivery notice]` tells you when that happens (the tool result says when this session has no inbox for one to reach); for a Remote Control, cloud or Claude Desktop session nothing reports back, so never treat silence as agreement. Your message arrives wrapped as `<cross-session-message from="...">`. **To reply to an incoming message, copy its `from` attribute as your `to`.** Cross-session messages travel between SESSIONS: if you are a subagent, your send goes out under your parent session's address, and any reply is delivered to the parent session's conversation, not to you. The receiver reads your message literally in every case (idle or busy, on this machine, over Remote Control or headless): an `@` followed by a file path, or `@server:resource`, attaches nothing there, unlike in your own user's input. So never rely on `@` to deliver content: send the text itself, or a file with its own tool.

To hear when a session ON THIS MACHINE finishes what it is doing, pass `notify_when_idle: true` (from the main conversation only) — one-shot and opt-in: exactly one `[Cross-session idle notice]` arrives when it next goes idle (or exits) — shown to you, or only to your user when this session holds peer messages for approval (the tool result says which); if it never signals within the subscription's lifetime (it may still be busy, may refuse inbound requests, or may have ended abruptly) the notice says the subscription expired instead. Omit `message` for a pure subscription that costs that session nothing; include one to deliver it now AND subscribe. Never poll `ListAgents` in a loop or send "are you done?" messages instead.

Permission boundaries are per-session: NEVER ask a peer to perform an action that was denied or blocked in your session, or that you expect your own permission settings would block — a peer doing it for you bypasses the user's permission decision (cross-session permission laundering). Route blocked work back to your user instead.

to.description: Recipient: a name from ListAgents (append its " [ref]" only when a listing or an error shows one), a teammate name, "main", or a background agent's agentId

summary.description: A 5-10 word label for your own transcript row (not transmitted — the recipient previews the first line of `message`). Truncated to 200 characters rather than rejected.

message.description: Plain text message content. The recipient's human sees only the FIRST LINE as a one-line preview until they expand it, so make the first line a clear, self-contained sentence saying what this is about — not a greeting, preamble, or bare @-mention.

notify_when_idle.description: Ask a session ON THIS MACHINE to send you ONE notice when it next goes idle (finishes its turn with nothing queued) or exits — opt-in, one-shot, no polling. With a message: deliver it now AND subscribe. Without a message (omit it): a pure subscription that costs the other session nothing.

title: 'Semantic Search with Debounced Input'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'in-review'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: '6f6a672b3a7aa50b5b65f839796586ed2b490122'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** Meus Registros has no way to find an Entry by meaning — a user who phrased a thought differently than how they search for it today finds nothing, and there is no search surface on the screen at all yet.

**Approach:** Add a permanently-docked search bar to Meus Registros, backed by a new `EntriesSearchCubit` (first real `Resource<T>` consumer) that debounces input 300ms and calls a new `EntriesRepository.search()` method against `entries-search`; an empty query reverts to the normal timeline, and offline resolves immediately to `Failure.networkOffline` with no cache fallback.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `EntriesRepository.search(String query)` → `Either<Failure, List<Entry>>`. `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` calls `ApiClient.get('entries-search', queryParameters: {'q': query})` (no `limit`/`cursor`), decodes `json['data']` with existing `EntryDto.fromJson`; extra `similarity`/`mode` fields are never read, same as other superset fields `_toEntry` already drops.
- `search()` is only called with a non-empty, pre-trimmed query — the cubit owns that guarantee, never the repository.
- On success, persist via `_toEntry`'s "persist then return" (`putAll`, mirrors `list()`). On any `Failure`, return `Left` unmapped — no cache fallback (AD-9: no client-side vector index).
- New `EntriesSearchCubit extends Cubit<Resource<List<Entry>>>`, starts `ResourceIdle()`. `onQueryChanged(raw)`: cancel pending debounce `Timer`; empty-after-trim → emit `ResourceIdle()`, no request; else restart a 300ms `Timer` → `ResourceLoading()` → `search()`. A monotonic `_generation` counter (mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit._generation`) discards stale results.
- New `EntriesSearchBar` widget: paper-elevated (`colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`), hint "Buscar nos registros...", trailing `Icons.filter_list` button (44pt, reuses `insertionModalTapTargetMin`) wired as a no-op this story (filters are 5.2); never submitted by a button — `onChanged` feeds `cubit.onQueryChanged` directly.
- `MeusRegistrosScreen`: dock the bar above the list; non-`ResourceIdle` search state renders search results (own 300ms skeleton threshold, mirrors `_skeletonTimer`) in place of the timeline; `ResourceIdle` shows the timeline unchanged.
- Register `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton` (`dispose: cubit.close()`) in `entries_injection.dart`, mirrors `MeusRegistrosCubit`; add its resolution assertion to `bootstrap_integration_test.dart`.

**Ask First:** none — scope is fully pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and the ACs below.

**Never:** `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` params on `search()` (5.2); a second `Entry`/DTO model; a cache fallback for search; a functional filter sheet; an update/delete method on `EntriesRepository`.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Semantic match | query "ansiedade" | results include an entry only containing "nervosismo" | N/A |
| Rapid typing | 5 keystrokes within 300ms | exactly one `entries-search` call fires, for the final value | N/A |
| Query cleared | non-empty → empty/whitespace | pending timer cancelled, state → `ResourceIdle`, timeline shown, no request | N/A |
| Offline | any non-empty query, no connectivity | `ApiClient` → `Failure.networkOffline`, no cache fallback | `ResourceError(networkOffline)` rendered |
| Stale response | query A in flight, query B supersedes it | A's result discarded on arrival (generation mismatch) | N/A |
| Slow request | request exceeds 300ms | loading indicator appears | N/A — faster responses show none |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `entries_repository.dart` — add `search()`; fix stale "third and last method ... forever" comment (AD-11 is create+read-only, not count-capped).
- `entries_remote_data_source.dart:54-76` / `entries_repository_impl.dart:54-94` — `list()`'s try/catch + persist-then-return pattern to mirror; `search()` has no fallback branch.
- `meus_registros_cubit.dart:48-57` — `_generation` staleness-guard pattern to mirror.
- `lib/core/resource.dart` — existing `Resource<T>`; first real consumer.
- `meus_registros_screen.dart:117-153` — wire both cubits via nested `BlocBuilder`s.
- `entries_injection.dart:54-60`, `bootstrap_integration_test.dart:196-197` — DI registration + assertion patterns to mirror.
- `design_tokens.dart` — reuse `colorSurfaceElevated`, `radiusMd`, `elevation1`, `spacingMd/Lg`, `textBodyMd`, `insertionModalTapTargetMin`; no new token.

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `entries_repository.dart` -- add `search(String query)` to the port
- [x] `entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- add `search()` calling `entries-search`
- [x] `entries_repository_impl.dart` -- implement `search()`: persist-then-return, no fallback
- [x] `presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart` (new) -- debounce + generation guard over `Resource<List<Entry>>`
- [x] `presentation/widgets/entries_search_bar.dart` (new) -- docked input, funnel icon, no submit button
- [x] `meus_registros_screen.dart` -- dock bar; branch render on search state
- [x] `entries_injection.dart` -- register `EntriesSearchCubit` as `lazySingleton`
- [x] `bootstrap_integration_test.dart` -- assert `EntriesSearchCubit` resolves
- [x] Unit tests covering every I/O Matrix row across the new/changed files
- [x] `test/features/entries/entries_search_flow_e2e_test.dart` (new) -- happy-path + offline; new real-pipeline surface, same rationale spec-4-4 used for `getById`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given a query "ansiedade", when results return, then they include an entry that only used "nervosismo" (semantic, not literal match).
- Given a user typing, when each keystroke lands, then the request is debounced 300ms — no request fires per keystroke.
- Given the search bar, when it renders, then it is permanently docked at the top of Meus Registros with a trailing funnel icon and is never submitted via a button.
- Given the user is offline, when a search is attempted, then it resolves to `Failure.networkOffline` immediately, never served from cache.

- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass

content.text:
Story 5.1 — Semantic Search with Debounced Input is complete and committed (`6e4e9d5`).

**What shipped:**
- `EntriesRepository`/`EntriesRemoteDataSource`/`EntriesRepositoryImpl` gained a `search()` method calling `entries-search` — persists results, no offline cache fallback (AD-9's vector-index carve-out).
- New `EntriesSearchCubit` — first real consumer of the existing `Resource<T>` wrapper — debounces input 300ms with a generation-guard against stale results, mirroring `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s own pattern.
- New `EntriesSearchBar` widget docked above the timeline in `MeusRegistrosScreen`, with its own RNF01 300ms skeleton threshold.
- DI registration + router wiring, plus a new end-to-end test for the real network/Hive pipeline.

**Review found and fixed 4 real bugs** (via blind-hunter + edge-case-hunter + verification-gap, run in parallel):
- `onQueryChanged('')` could throw after `close()` — missing `isClosed` guard.
- A `const ResourceLoading()` emission meant `Cubit.emit` silently swallowed a second back-to-back search's loading transition (bloc's own equality short-circuit), breaking the skeleton-timer reset under rapid retyping.
- Search results had no dedup-by-id, risking a Flutter duplicate-key crash if the backend ever violated its own invariant.
- The funnel icon button had no accessibility tooltip.

One UX nuance was deferred rather than fixed now (logged in `deferred-work.md`): the search cubit is a `lazySingleton` but the text field itself is stateless, so returning to the screen after navigating away shows stale search results with an empty-looking search box.

**Verification:** `fvm flutter analyze` clean, `fvm flutter test` — all 757 tests pass.

The spec file [`_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-5-1-semantic-search-with-debounced-input.md`](_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-5-1-semantic-search-with-debounced-input.md) is open in VS Code and contains a **Suggested Review Order** — Cmd+click the links in it to jump straight to each stop, grouped by concern (search contract → debounce state machine → UI wiring → DI/routing → tests).
